title.zh-TW: 沙盒內的 Bash 指令改採一般授權流程
title.en: Sandboxed Bash Commands Now Follow the Normal Permission Flow

items.original:
Changed sandboxed Bash commands to follow the normal permission flow by default; set `sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true` to keep running them without prompts
Changed managed settings that turn the sandbox on: to keep commands running without prompts, set `sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true` in your highest-ranking managed source

title.zh-TW: 沙盒攔截對更新目錄、worktree 與額外資料夾的寫入
title.en: Sandbox Blocks Writes to Updater Folders, Worktrees, and Added Directories

body.zh-TW:
讓指令在沙盒（sandbox，隔離執行的安全環境）裡跑的時候，程式能碰到的資料夾範圍現在收得更緊。以前沙盒裡的指令在某些情況下，依然寫得進原生更新程式的下載資料夾，這道漏洞已經修好。

針對開了 worktree（工作樹，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）的專案，Bash 沙盒過去沒能完整保護裡面的設定檔。同一套防護現在也覆蓋到當中的 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）。

如果是連結型的 worktree，它共用的 Git 資料夾同樣納入完整保護。

當你用額外加入的資料夾一起作業時，沙盒現在也會比照啟動資料夾的做法，拒絕沙盒內的指令寫入其中的 `.claude` 設定、技能、代理、自訂指令與 hook。
body.en:
When commands run inside a sandbox (an isolated security environment), the folders they can access are now more tightly restricted. Previously, sandboxed commands could still write to the native updater's download folder in some cases, and that gap is now fixed.

For projects using a worktree (a Git feature that lets you open parallel copies of the same project), the Bash sandbox previously failed to fully protect the settings files inside. The same protection now covers any hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) inside them as well.

For a linked worktree, its shared Git folder is now fully protected as well.

When you work with added directories, the sandbox now follows the same approach as the launch folder and refuses sandboxed writes to `.claude` settings, skills, agents, custom commands, and hooks inside them.

items.original:
Fixed sandboxed commands being able to write to the native updater's download folder in some cases
Fixed a case where the Bash sandbox did not fully protect a worktree's settings and hooks
Fixed a case where the Bash sandbox did not fully protect a linked worktree's shared git folder
Changed the sandbox to refuse sandboxed writes to `.claude` settings, skills, agents, commands and hooks in added directories, as it does in the launch folder

title.zh-TW: 沙盒輔助程式與本機工具不再帶入登入憑證與密碼
title.en: Sandbox Helpers and Local Tools No Longer Receive Sign-In Credentials or Passphrases

body.zh-TW:
Claude Code 在背景幫你跑搜尋或維持沙盒運作時，這些內部小幫手過去會在環境變數裡帶著你的敏感驗證資料。⟦好比請水電工進屋修水管時，以前會把整串鑰匙連同金庫密碼交給他，現在只遞上這趟維修需要的門卡。⟧

現在沙盒為自己啟動的程式，例如網路橋接器，執行環境裡不再帶有 Claude Code 的登入 token（授權令牌）與 API 金鑰。負責搜尋程式碼的 `ripgrep`、本機 Git 指令以及沙盒執行期的輔助程式，啟動時也不再把 mTLS 用戶端金鑰的密碼放進環境裡。
body.en:
When Claude Code runs searches in the background or keeps the sandbox running, those internal helpers previously carried your sensitive authentication data in their environment variables. ⟦Picture handing a plumber your entire keyring along with the safe combination just to fix a pipe, instead of giving them only the keycard needed for that visit.⟧

Now, programs that the sandbox starts for its own use, such as its network bridge, no longer have Claude Code's sign-in tokens (authorization credentials) and API keys in their environment. When `ripgrep` for code search, local Git commands, and the sandbox runtime's helper programs start up, they also no longer put the mTLS client key's passphrase into their environment.

items.original:
Changed the programs that Claude Code's sandbox starts for its own use, such as its network bridge, to run without Claude Code's sign-in tokens and API keys in their environment
Changed ripgrep, local git commands and the sandbox runtime's own helper programs to run without the mTLS client key's passphrase in their environment

title.zh-TW: 修正切換目錄、大小寫與重啟後漏接的權限規則
title.en: Fixed Permission Rules Missed After Directory Changes, Case Differences, and Restarts

body.zh-TW:
設定好禁止或詢問的權限規則後，之前在幾種常見操作下卻會意外失效。

像 `Read(./.env)` 這類相對路徑規則，過去只要執行過 `cd` 切換目錄就不再保護專案，現在修好了，連同額外加入的目錄也會一併套用。

以 `mcp__plugin_*_` 開頭的拒絕或詢問規則，過去遇到大小寫拼法不同的外掛 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器或工具會漏判，現在不分大小寫都能比對到。

在自架執行器（self-hosted runner）與 `claude remote-control` 工作階段裡，Claude Code 重啟後才送到的授權請求過去會漏掉拒絕規則，現在一樣會套用。從儲存庫特定子資料夾啟動時，已提交進版控的 `.claude/settings.local.json` 也不會再被誤當成你個人的設定檔。
body.en:
After you set up deny or ask permission rules, they could unexpectedly fail to apply under several common operations.

Relative path rules like `Read(./.env)` previously stopped protecting the project as soon as `cd` was run to change directories; this is now fixed, and they also apply in added directories.

Deny or ask rules starting with `mcp__plugin_*_` previously missed a plugin's MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools) server or tool when spelled in a different letter case, and now match regardless of case.

In self-hosted runner and `claude remote-control` sessions, permission approvals arriving after Claude Code restarts previously missed deny rules, and now have them applied. When starting from certain subfolders of a repository, a committed `.claude/settings.local.json` will no longer be mistaken for your personal settings file.

items.original:
Fixed relative deny and ask permission rules (e.g. `Read(./.env)`) no longer covering the project after a `cd`; they now also apply in added directories
Fixed deny and ask permission rules starting with `mcp__plugin_*_` missing a plugin's MCP server or tool spelled in another letter case
Fixed deny rules not being applied to a permission approval that arrives after Claude Code restarts, in self-hosted runner and `claude remote-control` sessions
Fixed a case where a committed `.claude/settings.local.json` could be treated as the user's own when Claude Code was started in certain subfolders of a repository

title.zh-TW: Bash 權限檢查補齊複合指令詢問與比對漏洞
title.en: Bash Permission Checks Close Compound Command Prompt and Matching Gaps

body.zh-TW:
透過權限清單把關終端機指令時，過去有三類 Bash 檢查漏洞會讓控管失效。

第一類是部分拒絕與詢問規則沒有套用到特定的 Bash 指令上，現在已修正。

第二類是多個指令串接在一起的複合指令，以前有些能跳過詢問直接跑；先前能跳過詢問的那些複合指令，現在會先詢問權限。

第三類是明明寫好只放行某支程式的 Bash 允許規則，在特定情況下卻可能跑到另一支不同程式，這個比對問題也已經修好。
body.en:
When guarding terminal commands with permission lists, three types of Bash check gaps previously allowed controls to be bypassed.

First, some deny and ask rules did not apply to certain Bash commands, which is now fixed.

Second, for compound commands chaining multiple commands together, some could previously run without asking; those compound commands that previously skipped prompts now ask for permission first.

Third, a Bash allow rule written to permit only one specific program could end up running a different program under certain conditions, and this matching issue has also been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed some deny and ask rules not applying to certain Bash commands
Fixed a gap in Bash permission checks where some compound commands could run without asking; these now ask for permission
Fixed a case where a Bash allow rule could run a different program than the one it names

title.zh-TW: 非專案且未信任的 Git 儲存庫執行唯讀指令改為先詢問
title.en: Read-Only Git Commands Now Ask First in Untrusted Non-Project Repositories

body.zh-TW: 當你請 Claude 順手檢查電腦裡另一個專案的程式紀錄，哪怕只是下 `git status` 這類唯讀的 Git 指令，只要那個儲存庫不屬於目前專案、也不是你信任過的目錄，現在都會先跳出來問你同不同意。⟦宛如在別人家書房翻閱資料夾，以前只要說明不動手修改就能直接開抽屜，現在房門外多了一道禮貌詢問，沒先打過招呼就不讓進。⟧如果你確實常要跨目錄查詢，想跳過每次詢問，啟動時請改用 `--add-dir` 參數點名該資料夾，不要寫在 `additionalDirectories` 設定裡。
body.en: When you ask Claude to check the code history of another project on your computer, even running a read-only Git command like `git status` will now prompt for your approval first if that repository does not belong to the current project or a directory you have trusted. ⟦Think of browsing folders in someone else's study: before, promising not to touch anything let you open the drawers right away, whereas now there is a polite check at the door so you cannot enter without saying hello first.⟧ If you regularly need to inspect across directories and want to skip prompting every time, name that folder with the `--add-dir` flag at startup instead of putting it in the `additionalDirectories` setting.

items.original: Changed read-only git commands to ask first in a repository that isn't the project's or one you trusted; name it with `--add-dir`, not the `additionalDirectories` setting, to run them without prompts

title.zh-TW: 排程任務、/loop 與「一律允許」規則收緊自動放行條件
title.en: Scheduled Tasks, /loop, and Always Allow Rules Tighten Automatic Approval

body.zh-TW:
設定好定時執行的排程任務或用 `/loop` 反覆跑工作時，如果該技能有宣告 `allowed-tools` 或 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），現在執行前會先問過你。想讓它在沒人盯場時自動跑，請把對應的 `Skill(name)` 加進設定的 `permissions.allow` 清單裡。

在桌面版、IDE 與 SDK 主環境裡按「Always allow（一律允許）」時也跟著調整：只有存下這條規則真的能讓該指令下次直接過關，畫面才會提供單純存規則的選項。⟦恰似替無人值守的夜間產線設定放行卡，以前隨手一張通行證就能沿用下去，現在發現權限不足以獨自過關就改為停機等你簽核。⟧
body.en:
When setting up scheduled tasks or running jobs repeatedly with `/loop`, if a skill declares `allowed-tools` or hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), it will now ask you before running. To let it run unattended, add the corresponding `Skill(name)` entry to `permissions.allow` in your settings.

Clicking "Always allow" in Desktop, IDE, and SDK hosts has also changed: saving a rule alone is offered only when that rule would actually let the command pass next time. ⟦Like issuing passcards for an unattended night shift on a production line, a casual pass used to carry over automatically, whereas now the line pauses for your sign-off if the permission is not enough to clear it on its own.⟧

items.original:
Changed scheduled tasks and `/loop` to ask before running a skill that declares `allowed-tools` or hooks; add `Skill(name)` to `permissions.allow` to run it unattended
Changed "Always allow" in Desktop, IDE and SDK hosts: a rule alone is offered only when saving it would allow that command again, so a scheduled task that relied on one can now wait for you

title.zh-TW: 修正 Artifact 讀取授權與對外公開內容的多次確認漏洞
title.en: Fixed Artifact Read Permissions and Confirmation Bypasses for Public Content

body.zh-TW:
使用互動成果面板（artifact）做成品時，權限把關以前常在該寬的時候卡住、該嚴的時候卻放水。現在讀取你自己建立的 artifact 或裡面的資料時，Claude 不再反覆跟你要權限。

雲端工作階段裡，針對 Artifact 工具設下的拒絕與詢問規則及 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），也修好過去漏套用的情況。

如果作品或頁面連組織外部的人都看得到，以前設過允許規則、先同意過上傳、或勾過 Artifact 的「不要再問」後，部分子代理修改、上傳檔案或發布頁面竟會直接跳過確認；現在這些對外動作都會先問你。在自動模式（auto mode）下也只會針對單次修改放行，不再只審第一次就一路核准後續改動。
body.en:
When working with artifacts (interactive output panels), permission checks previously tended to block where they should be lenient and let things slip where they should be strict. Now, when reading an artifact you created or its data, Claude no longer repeatedly asks you for permission.

In cloud sessions, deny and ask permission rules as well as hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) set for the Artifact tool have also been fixed so they are no longer skipped.

If an artifact or page is visible to people outside your organization, previously setting an allow rule, approving uploads earlier, or selecting "don't ask again" for Artifact could let some subagents modify it, upload files, or publish pages without confirmation; now all of these external-facing actions ask you first. Under auto mode, approval also covers only that single change instead of judging only the first edit and approving subsequent changes automatically.

items.original:
Fixed Claude asking for permission before reading your own artifact or its data
Fixed deny and ask permission rules and hooks for the Artifact tool not applying in some cloud sessions
Fixed some subagents changing an artifact that people outside your organization can see, or uploading files to it, without asking first when an allow rule is set or uploads were approved earlier
Fixed some artifact publishes skipping the confirmation for pages that people outside your organization can see when "don't ask again" had been chosen for Artifact
Fixed auto mode judging only the first change to an artifact that people outside your organization can see; its yes now covers that change alone

title.zh-TW: 雲端與自架執行器調整啟動條件、連線回傳與符號連結限制
title.en: Cloud and Self-Hosted Runners Adjust Startup Conditions, Connection Responses, and Symlink Limits

body.zh-TW:
在雲端環境與自架執行器上跑任務時，這版調整了多項連線與啟動邊界。掛有多個儲存庫的自架執行器工作階段，現在能用中途新增的儲存庫。

工作階段資料夾或儲存庫路徑為符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）時，自架執行器會拒絕。例外是 `checkout` hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）簽出的路徑。

網頁版 Claude Code、雲端排程與 Cowork 雲端工作階段，因代管容器無指令沙盒，設了 `sandbox.failIfUnavailable` 仍會啟動。經雲端或自架連線查設定、權限規則、hook 或狀態時回傳會變少或被拒，實際套用規則不變。雲端工作階段與 Remote Control 遇花費上限或共用預算錯誤時，也不再顯示「請管理員提高額度」。
body.en:
When running tasks on cloud environments and self-hosted runners, this release adjusts several connection and startup boundaries. Self-hosted runner sessions attached to multiple repositories can now use a repository added mid-session.

When a session folder or repository path is a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location), self-hosted runners will refuse it. An exception is a path checked out by a `checkout` hook (a small program triggered by specific events).

Claude Code on the web, cloud scheduled tasks, and Cowork cloud sessions still start even when `sandbox.failIfUnavailable` is set, because the hosted container has no command sandbox. Requests for settings, permission rules, hooks, or status over a cloud or self-hosted connection now return less or are refused, while the rules actually applied remain unchanged. Spend limit and shared budget errors in cloud sessions and under Remote Control also no longer display "ask your admin to raise it".

items.original:
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions with several repositories being unable to use a repository added mid-session
Changed Claude Code on the web, cloud scheduled tasks and Cowork cloud sessions to start despite `sandbox.failIfUnavailable`: the hosted container has no command sandbox
Changed requests for settings, permission rules, hooks or status over a cloud or self-hosted session's connection to return less or be refused; what applies in the session is unchanged
Changed self-hosted runners to refuse a session whose session folder or repository path is a symbolic link, other than a `checkout` hook's checkout
Removed "ask your admin to raise it" from spend limit and shared budget errors in cloud sessions and under Remote Control

title.zh-TW: 修正雲端連接器誤報失敗、自動作答與 Slack 提示問題
title.en: Fixed Cloud Connector False Failures, Auto-Answered Prompts, and Slack Tips

body.zh-TW:
在雲端工作階段串接外部服務連接器時，之前容易在載入與網址比對上出錯。當外掛用不同網址列出 Atlassian、Asana 或 Sentry 連接器時，明明能正常運作，Claude 卻會誤報它失敗，現在已修好。

連接器工具的授權詢問以前會在外掛仍載入時被自動回答，現在不會再搶先替你決定。若你所屬組織的政策本來就禁止雲端工作階段，畫面也不會再跳出 Slack 應用的推薦提示。
body.en:
When connecting external service connectors in cloud sessions, errors previously occurred during loading and URL matching. When a plugin listed an Atlassian, Asana, or Sentry connector at a different URL, Claude would falsely report that it had failed even though it was working, which is now fixed.

Approval prompts for connector tools were previously answered automatically while plugins were still loading, and will no longer decide for you ahead of time. If your organization's policy already denies cloud sessions, Slack app recommendation tips will no longer appear either.

items.original:
Fixed Slack app tips showing when your organization's policy denies cloud sessions
Fixed Claude saying a working Atlassian, Asana or Sentry connector had failed in cloud sessions when a plugin listed it at a different URL
Fixed a connector tool's approval prompt in cloud sessions being answered automatically while plugins were still loading

title.zh-TW: 沙盒與 worktree 補齊 Git 受阻提示、特殊架構相容與禁用清單
title.en: Sandboxes and worktrees add Git block notes, special-layout compatibility, and disallowed commands

body.zh-TW:
在沙盒或隔離副本裡操作 Git 時，有些指令會踩到環境限制而中斷。⟦猶如進借來的攝影棚拍片，能動哪些器材、哪幾盞燈不准碰都會先寫清楚，遇到鎖住的櫃子也不會乾站著不知所措。⟧

沙盒內的 `git checkout`、`git stash` 或 autostash pull 改不動 `.claude` 等受保護檔案時，會提示 Claude。

在純儲存庫的 worktree（工作樹，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）、`--separate-git-dir` 或 Android `repo` 目錄裡，`/security-review` 與技能內嵌 Git 指令不再報錯。隔離的 worktree 工作階段或代理禁用 `git bisect run`、`git maintenance register|start` 與 `scalar` 設定指令，並告知可用指令。
body.en:
Running Git inside a sandbox or isolated copy can hit environment limits that stop certain commands. ⟦A crew working on a borrowed soundstage gets a clear list of which gear they can touch and which lights stay off-limits, so they are never left staring at a locked cabinet.⟧

When a sandboxed `git checkout`, `git stash`, or autostash pull cannot update protected files such as those in `.claude`, Claude now receives a note.

In a bare repository's worktree (a Git feature for opening multiple parallel copies of a project), a `--separate-git-dir` checkout, or an Android `repo` checkout, `/security-review` and inline Git commands in skills no longer stop with an error. Isolated worktree sessions or agents now refuse `git bisect run`, `git maintenance register|start`, and `scalar` setup commands, and report which commands still work.

items.original:
Added a note for Claude when a sandboxed `git checkout`, `git stash` or autostash pull cannot update protected files such as those in `.claude`
Fixed `/security-review` and skills' inline git commands stopping with an error in worktrees of bare repositories, `--separate-git-dir` checkouts and Android `repo` checkouts
Changed worktree isolation: an isolated worktree session or agent is now refused `git bisect run`, `git maintenance register|start` and `scalar`'s set-up commands, and is told what still works

title.zh-TW: 修正 worktree 建置掛鉤、稀疏複製缺檔與容器信任規則
title.en: Fix worktree creation hooks, missing sparse-clone files, and container trust rules

body.zh-TW:
開立與掛載獨立副本的流程這版修掉了幾個環境邊角問題。換新家目錄首跑 `--worktree` 時，`CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR` 外掛的 `WorktreeCreate` hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）不再跳過。

在 Git 2.34 等舊版用 `worktree.sparsePaths` 與稀疏複製外掛與市集時，根目錄檔案不再漏掉。

若 `WorktreeCreate` hook 路徑經專案內符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），`EnterWorktree` 會拒絕，請印出真實路徑。在容器掛載 worktree（工作樹，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）或子模組跑 `-p` 與 SDK，只有資料夾受信任後，才套用 `.claude/settings.local.json` 裡的允許規則。
body.en:
This release fixes several environment edge cases around creating and mounting isolated copies. On the first `--worktree` run in a new home directory, a `WorktreeCreate` hook (a small program triggered by specific events) from a plugin in `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR` is no longer skipped.

On older Git versions such as 2.34, using `worktree.sparsePaths` as well as sparse plugin and marketplace clones no longer leaves out repository root files.

If a `WorktreeCreate` hook path goes through a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location) inside the project, `EnterWorktree` refuses it, so have the hook print the real path. When running `-p` and the SDK in a worktree (a Git feature for opening multiple parallel copies of a project) or submodule mounted into a container, allow rules in `.claude/settings.local.json` apply only after the folder is trusted.

items.original:
Fixed `--worktree` skipping a `WorktreeCreate` hook from a plugin in `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR` on the first run in a new home directory
Fixed `worktree.sparsePaths` and sparse plugin and marketplace clones leaving out the repository's root files on older git versions, such as 2.34
Changed EnterWorktree to refuse a `WorktreeCreate` hook path that goes through a symlink inside the project; have the hook print the real path
Changed `-p` and SDK runs in a worktree or submodule mounted into a container to apply `.claude/settings.local.json` allow rules only once the folder is trusted

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集補上安全風險提醒，支援完整 commit 指定與代理通道
title.en: Plugin marketplaces add security warnings, full commit pins, and proxy tunneling

body.zh-TW:
從外掛市集安裝擴充套件前，安全提示與連線規則都有調整。新增市集確認、外掛推薦提示與安裝警告，現在都會清楚告知外掛能在你電腦上執行程式碼，並存取檔案與終端機。

存取私有市集遇到 `HTTPS authentication failed` 時，訊息會說明 Git 的終端機互動提示與密碼詢問程式（askpass）已被停用，且這則提示在新版 Git 也會顯示。

市集的 `ref` 欄位現在接受分支或標籤上的完整 commit ID，但舊版用戶端無法複製這種指定方式，載入會失敗。若環境只設定了 `ALL_PROXY`，市集與外掛下載會改走 `CONNECT` 通道，遇到拒絕該通道的代理伺服器就會失敗。
body.en:
Security prompts and connection rules have been updated for installing extensions from plugin marketplaces. Add-marketplace confirmations, plugin recommendation prompts, and plugin install warnings now clearly state that plugins can run code on your computer with access to your files and shell.

When accessing a private marketplace hits `HTTPS authentication failed`, the message now notes that Git's terminal prompts and askpass programs are disabled, and it also appears with newer Git versions.

A marketplace's `ref` field now accepts the full ID of any commit on a branch or tag, though older clients cannot clone such a pin and will fail to load it. When `ALL_PROXY` is the only proxy set, marketplace and plugin downloads now use a `CONNECT` tunnel, so a proxy that refuses that tunnel fails them.

items.original:
Improved the `HTTPS authentication failed` message for private plugin marketplaces: it now says git's terminal prompts and askpass programs are disabled, and it also appears with newer git versions
Improved the add-marketplace confirmations, plugin recommendation prompts and plugin install warning to say that plugins can run code on your computer, with access to your files and shell
Changed marketplace `ref` to accept the full ID of any commit on a branch or tag; clients before this version can't clone such a pin, so a marketplace pinned this way stops loading there
Changed plugin marketplace and plugin downloads to use a CONNECT tunnel when `ALL_PROXY` is the only proxy set; a proxy that refuses CONNECT now fails them

title.zh-TW: 外掛改在 plugins 目錄解壓、跳過危險路徑並落實企業鎖定
title.en: Plugins unpack under plugins directory, skip unsafe paths, and enforce organization locks

body.zh-TW:
管理設定對代理與技能的 `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` 鎖定，現在對已開啟工作階段也生效。受管理遠端市集在 `prependPlugins` 或 `appendPlugins` 啟用的外掛視同組織外掛，並棄用忽略 `pluginDigests`。

外掛 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）套件 `.mcpb` 與 `.dxt` 改解壓於 plugins 目錄，唯讀資料夾就能載入。不再寫 `.mcpb-cache`（快取暫存目錄），網址套件重抓一次。

載入會跳過不安全路徑與連結，由 `claude plugin validate` 回報。`--plugin-dir` 外掛的 `.claude/skills` 不再從上層工作階段載入，請在該外掛資料夾啟動。
body.en:
Managed settings' `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` lock on agents and skills now takes effect in sessions that are already running. Plugins from a managed remote marketplace enabled in `prependPlugins` or `appendPlugins` count as the organization's plugins, while `pluginDigests` is deprecated and ignored.

Plugin MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) bundles `.mcpb` and `.dxt` now unpack under the plugins directory, allowing read-only plugin folders to load. They no longer write to `.mcpb-cache` (a temporary cache directory), and bundles fetched by URL download again once.

Plugin loading now skips unsafe paths and links, and `claude plugin validate` reports them. `.claude/skills` folders in `--plugin-dir` plugins no longer load from a session started above them; start in the plugin folder instead.

items.original:
Fixed a managed `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` lock on agents and skills not taking effect in sessions that were already running
Changed plugin MCP bundles (`.mcpb`, `.dxt`) to unpack under the plugins directory, not `.mcpb-cache` in the plugin's folder, so read-only plugin folders load; one fetched by URL downloads again once
Changed plugins of a remote marketplace that managed settings declare, enable and list in `prependPlugins` or `appendPlugins` to count as the organization's; `pluginDigests` is deprecated and ignored
Changed plugin loading to skip, and `claude plugin validate` to report, some unsafe paths and links in a plugin's folder
Changed nested skill loading: `.claude/skills` folders in `--plugin-dir` plugins no longer load from a session started above them; start Claude Code in the plugin folder instead

title.zh-TW: 修正 MCP 伺服器重連、授權刷新與資料夾移動後的連線狀態
title.en: Fix MCP server reconnection, auth refresh, and connection state after folder moves

body.zh-TW:
連接外部工具的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器過去切換與重連時容易卡在錯的狀態。

Claude Desktop 與 SDK 搬動資料夾或預熱啟動後，不再誤標、漏列 `.mcp.json` 本機伺服器或連不上 WebSocket。外掛重載移除連線中伺服器後，`/mcp` 不再殘留。

刷新 token（授權令牌）短暫被拒，伺服器不再卡在「needs authentication」。`mcp_tool` hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）也不再連帶被跳過。無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗或視覺介面的執行方式）下換連線時詢問不再直接取消，SDK 重連後也不誤答「Not connected」。
body.en:
MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers used to get stuck in the wrong state when switching or reconnecting.

After moving a folder or starting from a pre-warmed session, Claude Desktop and SDK sessions no longer mislabel or omit local `.mcp.json` servers or fail to connect WebSocket ones. `/mcp` also no longer keeps listing a plugin's server after a plugin reload removes it while connecting.

After a token (authorization credential) refresh is briefly refused, a server no longer stays stuck on "needs authentication". Its `mcp_tool` hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) are no longer skipped either. In headless mode (running without a terminal window or visual interface), prompts during a connection replacement are no longer cancelled without asking, and SDK tool calls no longer answer "Not connected" after reconnecting.

items.original:
Fixed Claude Desktop and SDK sessions listing a folder's own MCP servers (`.mcp.json`, local) as host-added or not at all, and not connecting WebSocket ones, after a folder move or pre-warmed start
Fixed `/mcp` still listing a plugin's MCP server after a plugin reload removed it while it was connecting
Fixed an MCP server staying "needs authentication", and its `mcp_tool` hooks being skipped, after a token refresh that was refused only for a moment
Fixed MCP elicitation requests being cancelled without asking in headless mode after a server's connection was replaced during a tool call
Fixed MCP tool calls from an SDK host answering "Not connected" after a tool call had reconnected the MCP server

title.zh-TW: 背景 MCP 任務提問不搶打字草稿，按 Esc 改為稍後回答
title.en: Background MCP task questions wait for your draft, and Esc means answer later

body.zh-TW:
背景執行的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）任務需要你做決定時，互動順暢度提升了不少。當你正在輸入訊息，背景任務的提問不會再直接蓋掉你打到一半的草稿，而是等你送出或清空後才出現，等待期間轉圈動畫與回合計時器也會繼續跑。

在提問視窗按下 Esc 現在代表「稍後回答」，不會傳任何東西給伺服器，問題會留在 `/tasks` 裡；過去按 Esc 關掉或重問後導致任務卡住的問題也已修好，現在頁尾會提示需要你輸入，進 `/tasks` 按 Enter 就能再叫出問題。

當同一伺服器在別次呼叫斷線、之後又由後續呼叫重連時，背景任務也會恢復更新；任務卡在等你回覆時，Claude 現在也會收到通知並引導你去 `/tasks`。
body.en:
Interaction is smoother when a background MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) task needs your decision. If you are typing a message, the task's question no longer opens over your draft and instead waits until you send or clear it, while the spinner and turn timer keep running.

Pressing Esc on the question prompt now means "answer later", sending nothing to the server and keeping the question in `/tasks`. Tasks no longer get stuck after closing a question with Esc or asking it again; the footer now notes that your input is needed, and pressing Enter in `/tasks` shows the question again.

Background tasks also resume updating when another call to the same server loses the connection and a later call reconnects. When a task is waiting for your answer, Claude is now notified and can point you to `/tasks`.

items.original:
Fixed an MCP task getting stuck after its question was closed with Esc or asked again: the footer now says it needs your input, and Enter in `/tasks` shows the question again
Fixed background MCP tasks that stopped updating after another call to the same server lost the connection, when a later call reconnects
Fixed a background MCP task's question opening over a message you were still typing; it now waits until you send or clear the draft, and the spinner and turn timer keep running
Improved MCP tasks: Claude is now told when a task is waiting for your answer, and can point you to `/tasks`
Changed Esc on a background MCP task's question to "answer later": nothing is sent to the server, and the question stays in `/tasks`

title.zh-TW: 修正 /login 與桌面版登入中途取消覆蓋帳號與成功頁誤判
title.en: Fix /login and desktop sign-in cancellation overwrites and false success pages

body.zh-TW:
登入帳號遇到中斷或卡關時，狀態處理與提示改動讓每一步都有明確回饋。⟦好比飯店櫃檯辦理入住時，取消新登記不再把原本房卡消磁，辦理失敗不亮入住綠燈，更改隱私條款前會先問你，被擋下時也直接指出是哪張卡出了問題。⟧

在 `/login` 選擇「用 Console 主控台帳號登入」後，若在瀏覽器步驟剛結束時按 Esc 取消，原本已登入的帳號不再被蓋掉。登入失敗或被取消時，瀏覽器也不再出現顯示登入成功的誤導頁面。

執行 `/login` 若會更動你的隱私設定，現在會先徵求你的同意。從終端機執行 `claude --desktop` 卻無法用 Claude 帳號登入時，錯誤訊息現在會直接點名是哪一組 API 金鑰、服務提供者或設定項目擋住了登入。
body.en:
When sign-in is interrupted or blocked, updated state handling and prompts give clear feedback at every step. ⟦At a hotel check-in desk, canceling a new registration no longer demagnetizes your existing room key, a failed check-in no longer flashes a green welcome light, privacy changes ask you first, and any block points straight to the card causing trouble.⟧

In `/login`, choosing "Sign in with your Console account" and pressing Esc right after the browser step no longer replaces your existing login. When sign-in fails or is canceled, the browser also no longer displays a misleading sign-in success page.

If running `/login` will change your privacy settings, it now asks for your permission first. When `claude --desktop` fails to sign in with a Claude account, the error message now names the specific API key, provider, or setting blocking it.

items.original:
Fixed "Sign in with your Console account" in `/login` replacing your existing login when you pressed Esc right after the browser step
Fixed the browser showing the sign-in success page in some cases where sign-in failed or was canceled
Improved the `claude --desktop` sign-in error to name the API key, provider or setting that stops a Claude account sign-in from working
Changed `/login` to ask for permission to change your privacy settings

title.zh-TW: 清理驗證鎖定檔並加快無金鑰主控台啟動速度
title.en: Clean up auth lock files and speed up keyless Console startup

body.zh-TW:
帳號驗證用的鎖定檔過去偶爾會殘留或拖慢啟動速度。現在設定目錄裡不會再堆積遺留的 `.oauth_refresh.lock.owner.tmp.*` 暫存檔，而 `claude auth status` 等短指令也不會在主控台（Console）設定檔留下鎖定檔，讓下一個工作階段卡住約一分鐘。

使用無金鑰主控台登入或其他 Anthropic 設定檔啟動時，只要 token（授權令牌）還在有效期內，就會直接讀取，不必乾等憑證鎖定解除。

若在沒有任何帳號資料快取（cache，把查過的資料暫存起來直接用）的乾淨環境執行 `claude -p`，它現在會在送出第一次請求前先等資料抓完，所以首次執行可能會慢幾秒啟動。
body.en:
Authentication lock files used to pile up or slow down startup. Leftover `.oauth_refresh.lock.owner.tmp.*` temporary files no longer accumulate in the config directory, and short commands such as `claude auth status` no longer leave a lock behind on a Console profile that makes the next session hang for about a minute.

When starting with a keyless Console sign-in or another Anthropic profile login, a token (authorization credential) that is still valid is read directly without waiting for the credentials lock.

If you run `claude -p` in a clean environment with no cached account data, it now waits to fetch that data before sending its first request, so a first run can start a few seconds later.

items.original:
Fixed leftover `.oauth_refresh.lock.owner.tmp.*` files piling up in the config directory
Fixed `claude auth status` and other short commands leaving a lock behind on a Console profile, which made the next session hang for about a minute
Improved startup with a keyless Console sign-in or other Anthropic profile login: a token that is still valid is read without waiting for the credentials lock
Changed `claude -p` with no cached account data to wait for that data before its first request, so a first run in a clean environment can start a few seconds later

title.zh-TW: 背景工作階段不再誤扣殼層 API 金鑰並拒絕跨帳號轉移
title.en: Background sessions stop billing shell API keys and refuse cross-account moves

body.zh-TW:
把任務丟到背景執行時，計費與帳號邊界這版守得更嚴格。⟦就像餐廳聚餐各開各的帳單，不誤刷隔壁桌主人的信用卡，也不給把帳單硬轉到別桌，離席多按一下鈴也不會撤掉正在煮的菜。⟧

以 claude.ai 帳號啟動的背景工作階段，過去可能會誤用並扣款自啟動該服務的殼層環境裡的 API 金鑰或 token（授權令牌），這個問題已經修好。工作階段在背景被轉移到另一個登入帳號的情況現在會直接拒絕，並附上可行的替代做法。

如果轉到背景的要求被拒絕，之後在離開對話框多按一次 Enter，也不會停掉背景工作。當背景工作階段無法使用自己的 API 金鑰或 token 時，提示訊息也不再誤導你把金鑰寫進設定檔。
body.en:
Billing and account boundaries are now enforced more strictly when moving tasks to the background. ⟦Separate tabs at a group dinner keep everyone's charges apart, so you never accidentally swipe the host's card at the next table, cannot force a bill onto another party, and will not cancel food already on the stove just by ringing the exit bell twice.⟧

Background sessions started on your claude.ai login no longer accidentally use and bill an API key or token (authorization credential) from the shell that started the background service. Moves of a session to another sign-in in the background are now refused with a message explaining what works instead.

If a move to the background was refused, pressing a second Enter in the exit dialog no longer stops background work. When a background session cannot use its own API key or token, the shown messages no longer suggest adding the key to settings.

items.original:
Fixed background sessions started on your claude.ai login using (and billing) an API key or token from the shell that started the background service
Fixed more cases of a session moving to another sign-in in the background; these moves are now refused, with a message saying what works
Fixed a second Enter in the exit dialog stopping background work after the move to the background was refused
Improved the messages shown when a background session can't use its session's API key or token: they no longer suggest adding the key to settings

title.zh-TW: 修正組織限制誤報、Bedrock 權限與雲端憑證環境相容
title.en: Fix false organization restrictions, Bedrock permissions, and cloud credential compatibility

body.zh-TW:
遇到組織權限檢查或雲端帳號驗證時，之前有幾處誤判與漏擋已經修好。在無金鑰主控台（Console）登入下，`/fast` 不會再沒問過伺服器就說組織停用了快速模式；連不上網路導致無法檢查時，`/model` 也不再誤報組織限制了該模型。

設定了 `allowedProviders` 卻不允許使用 Amazon Bedrock 時，計算 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數量不會再把對話送往 Bedrock。缺少 `HOME` 環境變數啟動時，AWS `credential_process` 輔助程式與 Google Cloud 預設憑證也能正常運作。

等 Claude Desktop 整合這個版本後，第三方部署在更新 token 期間不會再一直卡在「Stopping」。
body.en:
Several false errors and missed checks around organization permissions and cloud credentials are now fixed. Under keyless Console sign-in, `/fast` no longer claims fast mode is disabled by your organization without asking the server, and `/model` no longer reports an organization restriction when network issues prevent checking.

When the `allowedProviders` setting does not allow Amazon Bedrock, counting tokens (text units AI uses for processing and billing) no longer sends the conversation to Bedrock. AWS `credential_process` helpers and Google Cloud default credentials also work properly when started without a `HOME` environment variable.

Once Claude Desktop includes this version, third-party deployments will no longer stay stuck on "Stopping" during a token renewal.

items.original:
Fixed `/fast` saying "Fast mode has been disabled by your organization" under the keyless Console sign-in, where Claude Code had not asked the server
Fixed `/model` saying that your organization restricts a model when Claude Code could not check that, for example with no network
Fixed token counting on Amazon Bedrock sending the conversation to Bedrock when the `allowedProviders` managed setting does not allow it
Fixed AWS `credential_process` helpers and Google Cloud default credentials failing when Claude Code is started without a `HOME` environment variable
Fixed Claude Desktop's third-party deployments staying on "Stopping" until a token renewal finished (once it includes this version)

title.zh-TW: 子代理守住各自模型、權限隔離與輸出上限重試
title.en: Subagents Keep Their Own Models, Permission Isolation, and Output-Limit Retries

body.zh-TW:
派出子代理分頭做事時，過去常把主工作階段的模型與權限混在一起。⟦如同廚房派幾位幫廚分頭備料，各自帶好自己的食譜與鍋具、算份量用自己的碗，報告寫太長被截斷就請他精簡重報整份。⟧

現在就算全域模型設為 `opusplan` 或 `haiku`，自帶專屬模型的子代理不會再被切去計畫模式的模型；使用不同模型的子代理在估算讀檔與 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）結果大小時，也會改用自己的模型來算。

子代理的計畫核准後，主工作階段不再莫名退回先前的權限模式。斜線指令給出的 `allowed-tools` 授權，也不會外溢給執行期間或之後才喚醒的背景代理。若子代理講到一半撞到輸出 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）上限被截斷，現在會請它把整份答案用更精簡的方式重答一遍，而非只交回後半段。
body.en:
When you dispatch subagents to work in parallel, the main session's model and permissions used to get mixed together with theirs. ⟦When a kitchen sends prep cooks to work in parallel, each brings their own recipe and pots, measures portions with their own bowl, and if a report runs too long and gets cut off, they are asked to summarize and resubmit the whole thing.⟧

Now, even when the global model is set to `opusplan` or `haiku`, subagents with their own dedicated model are no longer switched to the plan-mode model, and subagents on a different model now size file reads and MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) results using their own model.

After a subagent's plan is approved, the main session no longer reverts unexpectedly to an earlier permission mode. `allowed-tools` grants from a slash command also no longer leak to background agents woken during or after its turn. If a subagent is cut off mid-response at the output token (a unit of text AI processes and bills by) limit, it is now asked to provide the whole answer again more briefly instead of returning only the second half.

items.original:
Fixed subagents with their own model being moved to the plan-mode model when the model setting is `opusplan` or `haiku`
Fixed subagents on a different model sizing file reads and MCP results with the main session's model
Fixed a session sometimes going back to an earlier permission mode after a subagent's plan was approved
Fixed a slash command's `allowed-tools` grants applying to background agents woken during or after its turn
Improved subagents cut off at the output token limit: they are now asked for the whole answer again, more briefly, instead of returning only its end

title.zh-TW: 第三方閘道器與自訂模型 ID 正常壓縮並套用脈絡上限
title.en: Third-Party Gateways and Custom Model IDs Compact Properly and Apply Context Limits

body.zh-TW:
透過第三方閘道器（gateway）或 Foundry 連上模型時，脈絡長度與模型代號過去容易水土不服。過去許多工作階段塞滿對話後不會自動壓縮（compact），而是每回合都直接報脈絡長度錯誤停擺，現在已修好。

新安裝環境裡原本存好的 `sonnet[1m]` 模型設定，也不會再被改寫成 API 拒收的模型代號。環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` 現在也能替閘道器的 `claude-sonnet-latest` 這類 `claude-` 開頭未知模型代號，設定完整的脈絡視窗 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）上限。
body.en:
When connecting to models through a third-party gateway or Foundry, context lengths and model IDs used to run into compatibility issues. Previously, many sessions that filled up with conversation would not auto-compact and instead stopped with a context length error on every turn; this is now fixed.

A saved `sonnet[1m]` model setting on a new install is also no longer rewritten to a model ID the API rejects. The `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` environment variable can now also set the full context window token (a unit of text AI processes and bills by) limit for unrecognized model IDs starting with `claude-`, such as a gateway's `claude-sonnet-latest`.

items.original:
Fixed sessions on many third-party gateways and Foundry stopping with a context length error on every turn instead of compacting
Fixed a saved `sonnet[1m]` model setting being rewritten on a new install to a model id the API rejects
Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` to also set the context window of unrecognized model IDs that start with `claude-`, such as a gateway's `claude-sonnet-latest`

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 修正 worktree 路徑、同意附言與接續等待
title.en: Code Mode Fixes Worktree Paths, Approval Notes, and Resume Waiting

body.zh-TW:
在 Code Mode 跑腳本時，以前容易出現路徑寫錯、訊息漏傳或擅自開工的狀況。現在腳本會正確留在你用 `EnterWorktree` 進入的 worktree（工作樹，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）裡執行，不再把開頭為 `~` 的路徑寫進專案。

遇到登入過期的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，`/mcp` 畫面也不會繼續誤標為已連線。在權限確認或計畫核准時選「Yes」並順手輸入的補充說明，現在能確實傳給 Claude；接續一個在 Code Mode 腳本途中結束的工作階段時，它也會乖乖等你下達下一條指令，不會自己開工。
body.en:
When running scripts in Code Mode, wrong paths, dropped messages, or premature execution used to happen easily. Scripts now properly stay inside the worktree (a Git feature for opening multiple parallel copies of the same project) you entered with `EnterWorktree`, instead of writing paths starting with `~` into the project.

When encountering an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) server whose sign-in has expired, the `/mcp` screen also no longer keeps showing it as connected. Extra notes typed when selecting "Yes" at a permission dialog or plan approval now reliably reach Claude, and when you resume a session that ended mid-way through a Code Mode script, it waits for your next prompt instead of starting work on its own.

items.original:
Fixed Code Mode scripts ignoring a worktree entered with `EnterWorktree`, writing `~` paths into the project, and leaving `/mcp` showing an MCP server as connected after its sign-in expired
Fixed words typed with a Yes at a permission dialog or plan approval not reaching Claude in Code Mode
Fixed Claude starting work by itself when you resumed a session that ended during a Code Mode script; it now waits for your next prompt

title.zh-TW: 補齊 OpenTelemetry 的回合中與合併排隊 user_prompt 事件
title.en: Fill Missing Mid-Turn and Merged-Queue OpenTelemetry user_prompt Events

body.zh-TW:
如果你有開啟 OpenTelemetry 收集遙測紀錄，先前兩種發送訊息的情境會漏記提示文字。當 Claude 正在跑工具呼叫、你中途插話送出訊息時，以前會漏發 `user_prompt` 事件，現在已補上並帶有 `delivery.mode: "mid_turn"` 與當前回合的 `prompt.id`。

在 VS Code 裡若有多則排隊訊息合併成同一回合，或其中一則帶有圖片，以前 `user_prompt` 事件會漏掉前面幾則的文字，現在也會完整記錄下來。
body.en:
If you have OpenTelemetry enabled to collect telemetry logs, two message-sending scenarios previously missed recording prompt text. When you sent a message mid-turn while Claude was running tool calls, the `user_prompt` event used to be missing; it is now included with `delivery.mode: "mid_turn"` and the running turn's `prompt.id`.

In VS Code, when multiple queued messages merged into one turn, or when one message included an image, the `user_prompt` event previously left out the earlier messages' text; it now records them in full.

items.original:
Fixed a missing OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event for a message sent while tool calls run. The event has `delivery.mode: "mid_turn"` and the running turn's `prompt.id`
Fixed the OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event leaving out earlier messages' text when queued messages merged into one turn in VS Code, or when one message had an image

title.zh-TW: 修正終端機專注檢視、捲動遮擋與窄螢幕排版錯亂
title.en: Fix Terminal Focus View, Scroll Overlaps, and Narrow-Screen Layout Glitches

body.zh-TW:
終端機畫面的顯示與捲動錯位問題這版一次清掉不少。在專注檢視（focus view）裡，排程任務緊接著回覆時不再把你剛得到的回答蓋掉；沒開全螢幕時，背景子代理的畫面也不會漏掉你的原始提示。

清單與權限詢問的長選項換行時不再被局部覆蓋，窄終端機的初次啟動畫面也不會掉行。啟動時關於權限規則的警告與「N MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）servers need authentication」通知，即使被捲出畫面外，也不再被誤記成你已經看過。

若代理名稱或工作資料夾裡含有控制字元或換行，歡迎頁標題也不再直接印出控制字元或斷成兩行。
body.en:
Several terminal display and scroll-alignment issues are cleaned up in this release. In focus view, a scheduled task's subsequent reply no longer hides the answer you just received. When fullscreen is off, a background subagent's view no longer drops your original prompt.

Long options in lists and permission prompts are no longer partly overwritten when they wrap, and first-run screens on narrow terminals no longer lose lines. Startup warnings about permission rules and the "N MCP servers need authentication" notice (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) are also no longer recorded as seen when scrolled out of view.

If an agent's name or the working folder contains control characters or a line break, the welcome header no longer prints raw control characters or splits across two lines.

items.original:
Fixed focus view hiding the reply to your prompt when a scheduled task replied after it
Fixed the prompt sometimes missing from a background subagent's view when fullscreen is off
Fixed long options in lists and permission prompts being partly overwritten when they wrap, and first-run screens losing lines on narrow terminals
Fixed startup warnings about permission rules and the "N MCP servers need authentication" notice being recorded as seen when they were scrolled out of view
Fixed the welcome header showing control characters or splitting across lines when an agent's name or the working folder contains them or a line break

title.zh-TW: 終端機與 IDE 補上操作導引文字，並修正快速啟動快捷鍵顯示
title.en: Terminal and IDE Add Guidance Prompts and Fix Quick Launch Shortcut Display

body.zh-TW:
操作遇到阻礙或剛開啟環境時，畫面上的提醒變得具體好懂。當 Claude 讀過或改過 Jupyter 筆記本後，VS Code 與同類整合終端機的轉圈提示現在會提醒你可以重跑筆記本儲存格。

若請求被所屬組織的政策擋下，錯誤訊息下方現在會加一行操作建議，告訴你可以執行 `/rewind` 修改訊息或用 `/clear` 繼續。當 Claude 嘗試執行只有你本人能跑的指令而跳出紅字錯誤時，下方也會補上一行淡色文字，說明這條指令必須由你在輸入列親手鍵入才會執行。

在 Windows 與 Linux 上，IDE 歡迎對話框不再錯誤顯示 Mac 專用的 `Cmd+Esc` 作為快速啟動（Quick Launch）快捷鍵。
body.en:
On-screen reminders when hitting a snag or opening your environment are now more concrete and clear. Once Claude has read or edited a Jupyter notebook, the spinner tip in VS Code and similar integrated terminals now reminds you to re-run the notebook cell.

If a request is blocked by your organization's policy, a line of next-step advice now appears below the error telling you to run `/rewind` to change the message or `/clear` to continue. When Claude tries to run a command that only you can run and triggers a red error, a dim line below it now explains that the command only runs when you type it at the prompt.

On Windows and Linux, the IDE welcome dialog no longer mistakenly shows the Mac-only `Cmd+Esc` shortcut for Quick Launch.

items.original:
Added a spinner tip in VS Code and similar integrated terminals about re-running a notebook cell, shown once Claude has read or edited a Jupyter notebook
Added a line under the error shown when your organization's policy blocks a request, saying how to continue: run `/rewind` and change the message, or run `/clear`
Fixed the red error shown when Claude tries a command only you can run: a dim line now says it runs only when you type it at the prompt
Fixed the IDE welcome dialog showing Cmd+Esc for Quick Launch on Windows and Linux

title.zh-TW: 修正 claude purge、外掛評估空路徑與 -p 終端機輸出異常
title.en: Fix claude purge, Empty Plugin Eval Output Path, and -p Terminal Output

body.zh-TW:
在終端機直接下達幾條獨立 CLI 指令時，過去遇到無互動介面或特殊參數會卡住或寫錯地方。執行 `claude purge` 時若沒有終端機可讀取按鍵，以前會靜靜卡死，而標準輸入（stdin，從管線或檔案送進程式的資料流）接了管線時，它的專案選擇器與 `-i` 提示也會忽略鍵盤操作，現在都已修好。

執行 `claude plugin eval --output-dir ''` 傳入空路徑時，不再把報告直接寫進目前資料夾，而是會直接報錯結束。`claude -p` 在終端機上輸出的純文字，現在也不再夾帶文字樣式以外的控制序列，接管線或輸出到檔案的行為則維持不變。
body.en:
Running several standalone CLI commands directly in the terminal used to hang or write to the wrong place when there was no interactive interface or when given special arguments. Running `claude purge` without a terminal to read keys from no longer hangs silently, and its project picker and `-i` prompts no longer ignore the keyboard when stdin (standard input, the data stream fed into a program from a pipe or file) is piped.

Running `claude plugin eval --output-dir ''` with an empty path no longer writes the report into the current folder and instead exits with an error. Plain text output from `claude -p` on a terminal also no longer includes control sequences other than text styling, while pipes and file output remain unchanged.

items.original:
Fixed `claude purge` hanging silently when there is no terminal to read keys from, and its project picker and `-i` prompts ignoring the keyboard when stdin is piped
Fixed `claude plugin eval --output-dir ''` writing the report into the current folder; it now exits with an error
Fixed `claude -p` text output on a terminal passing control sequences other than text styling; pipes and files are unchanged

title.zh-TW: 修正 /stats 天數多算、/insights 空報告與意見回報上傳範圍
title.en: Fix /stats Day Count, Empty /insights Reports, and Feedback Upload Scope

body.zh-TW:
檢視使用統計與回報問題時，幾條相關斜線指令的數字與資料範圍都有校正。`/stats` 顯示的活躍天數（Active days）總計過去會多出一天，這項偏差已經修正。

使用 `/insights` 時，若根本沒有任何工作階段符合分析條件，不再誤報報告已產出；產出的 HTML 報告裡原本有兩個欄位沒先做跳脫處理就直接寫入，也一併修好。

在透過 `/feedback` 與 `/bug` 送出意見時，連帶上傳其他工作階段紀錄前，現在會確認它們確實是由目前登入帳號或所屬組織所記錄。
body.en:
When viewing usage stats or reporting issues, counts and data scopes across several slash commands have been corrected. The Active days total shown by `/stats` used to be one day too high, and that offset is now fixed.

When using `/insights`, if no session qualifies for analysis, it no longer falsely reports that a report is ready, and two fields in the generated HTML report that were previously written without escaping are now fixed as well.

When sending feedback via `/feedback` and `/bug`, before uploading other session logs alongside it, it now verifies that they were recorded by the currently signed-in account or organization.

items.original:
Fixed `/stats` showing an Active days total that was one day too high
Fixed `/insights` saying a report was ready when no session qualified for analysis, and writing two values into its HTML report without escaping them
Fixed `/feedback` and `/bug` to upload other sessions only when they were recorded by the signed-in account or organization

title.zh-TW: /voice 顯示語音鎖定來源，收不到音時指引切換麥克風
title.en: /voice Shows What Locks Voice Mode and Guides Microphone Switching

body.zh-TW:
開著語音模式（`/voice`）卻沒反應或切不動開關時，現在會直接告訴你卡在哪裡。⟦像開視訊會議前發現無法切換音效，畫面直接告訴你是總機設定鎖住了開關，還是要進哪個選單改選麥克風，不用再自己逐個按鈕盲試。⟧

過去就算管理設定、`--settings` 或專案裡的 `.claude/settings.json`、`.claude/settings.local.json` 把語音模式鎖住不讓改動，`/voice` 仍會誤報已切換，現在會明確指出是哪一份設定卡住它。在 macOS 與 Windows 上如果跳出「No audio detected」收不到聲音的提示，現在也會寫明要去哪裡挑選你的麥克風。
body.en:
When voice mode (`/voice`) does not respond or refuses to toggle, it now tells you directly where it is stuck. ⟦Imagine trying to switch audio before a video call and seeing on screen whether the main switchboard locked the toggle or which menu lets you pick a different microphone, instead of blindly clicking every button.⟧

Previously, even when managed settings, `--settings`, or the project's `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` kept voice mode locked, `/voice` still falsely reported that it had changed; it now states clearly which setting holds it. On macOS and Windows, when the "No audio detected" message appears, it now also specifies where to pick your microphone.

items.original:
Fixed `/voice` saying voice mode changed when managed settings, `--settings`, or the project's `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` kept it as it was; it now says what holds it
Improved the `/voice` "No audio detected" message on macOS and Windows: it now says where to pick your microphone

title.zh-TW: 隊友模式無效值會出警告，新開子工作階段改從原資料夾出發
title.en: Invalid Teammate Mode Values Trigger Warnings and New Sub-Sessions Start in Original Folder

body.zh-TW:
設定多代理協作與開新畫面時的起點，這版處理得比過去清楚。⟦恰似派同隊成員去支援時，大家統一在專案工地門口集合出發，不會跟著上一位同事臨時繞去的超商位置開工。⟧

設定檔裡的 `teammateMode` 若填了認不得的值，以前會默默被跳過不吭聲；現在 `claude -p`、啟動警告與 `claude doctor` 都會把它列為已略過的項目（仍不會套用）。開啟 tmux 與 iTerm2 隊友，或是從代理檢視畫面按左鍵 `←` 開啟新工作階段時，起始目錄也不再跟著殼層最後一次 `cd` 的位置跑，而是改在原本工作階段的資料夾啟動。
body.en:
Configuring multi-agent collaboration and the starting point for new views is handled more clearly in this release. ⟦Suppose a team dispatches members to help out: everyone meets at the project site gate to start together, rather than starting from the convenience store the previous colleague detoured to.⟧

If `teammateMode` in settings has an unrecognized value, it used to be silently ignored; now `claude -p`, the startup warning, and `claude doctor` all list it as a skipped entry (still not applied). Opening tmux and iTerm2 teammates, or starting a new session from the agents view with `←`, also no longer starts in the directory where the shell last ran `cd`, and instead starts in the original session's folder.

items.original:
Fixed an unrecognized `teammateMode` settings value being ignored without a warning: `claude -p`, the startup warning and `claude doctor` now list it as a skipped entry (still not applied)
Changed tmux and iTerm2 teammates, and new sessions from the agents view opened with ←, to start in the session's folder instead of where the shell last ran `cd`

title.zh-TW: 計畫寫不進目標目錄改存預設資料夾，重要檔案避開草稿暫存區
title.en: Plans fall back to the default folder when unwritable, keeping important files out of the scratchpad

body.zh-TW:
好不容易敲定的計畫或產出的檔案，這版降低了它們存錯位置而遺失的風險。⟦好似在烘焙坊包好剛出爐的麵包後，發現指定禮盒裝不下時會先裝進標準紙袋並附紙條說明，也提醒學徒別把客人的成品擺在等一下就要整盤倒掉的試吃盤上。⟧

當一份已核准的計畫修改無法寫進自訂的 `plansDirectory` 資料夾時，現在不再直接丟失，而是改存回預設的計畫資料夾，並跳出警告說明存到哪裡與原因。Claude 的內建指引也調整過，要求它別把你之後還需要的檔案放進可能會被清空的暫存草稿資料夾（scratchpad）裡。
body.en:
This release lowers the risk of losing hard-won plans or generated files because they were saved to the wrong place. ⟦Just as a bakery wraps fresh loaves in a standard paper bag with an explanatory note when the requested gift box is too small, it also reminds apprentices not to leave a customer's finished item on a sample tray that will soon be dumped out.⟧

When an approved plan edit cannot be written to your custom `plansDirectory` folder, it is no longer lost; instead, it is saved back to the default plans folder with a warning explaining where it went and why. Claude's built-in instructions have also been updated so it avoids placing files you will still need later inside a temporary scratchpad (a draft folder that can be cleared).

items.original:
Fixed an approved plan edit being lost when the `plansDirectory` folder can't take it: the plan is now saved in the default plans folder, and a warning says where and why
Changed Claude's instructions to keep files you'll want out of its temporary scratchpad folder, which can be cleared

title.zh-TW: Windows 版修正 PATH 權限卡頓與 /resume 磁碟代號大小寫問題
title.en: Windows fixes PATH permission stalls and /resume drive-letter case issues

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 環境啟動或接續舊對話時，先前有三個路徑與權限相關的毛病已經修好。若環境變數 `PATH` 裡有項目落在你帳號打不開的資料夾底下，過去啟動時可能會卡住約一秒，現在不會再這樣拖慢。

使用 `/resume` 恢復工作階段時，如果紀錄裡的磁碟機代號大小寫或斜線方向跟目前不一樣，過去會拒開或把該工作階段藏起來，現在已修好。在工作階段內執行 `/resume` 時，若紀錄裡的磁碟機代號大小寫不同，過去會弄丟專案已儲存的信任狀態，這個問題也已解決。
body.en:
Three path and permission issues that affected starting up or continuing older conversations on Windows have been fixed. If an entry in the `PATH` environment variable sits under a folder your account cannot open, startup could previously stall for about a second, which no longer happens.

When using `/resume` to restore a session whose recorded drive-letter case or slash direction differed from the current one, it previously refused to open or hid the session, and that is now fixed. Running `/resume` inside a session also no longer drops a project's saved trust state when the recorded drive-letter case differs.

items.original:
Windows: Fixed a start-up stall that could last about a second when a PATH entry sits under a folder your account cannot open
Fixed `/resume` on Windows refusing or hiding sessions whose folder was recorded with a different drive-letter case or slashes
Fixed an in-session `/resume` on Windows dropping a project's saved trust when the session was recorded with a different drive-letter case

title.zh-TW: Linux 版修正符號連結家目錄下的沙盒 Bash 建檔失敗
title.en: Linux fixes sandboxed Bash file creation failures under symlinked home directories

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 上，你可能把工作目錄放在 `allowRead`（允許讀取的資料夾）底下。若這個資料夾又位於 `denyRead`（禁止讀取的範圍）內，沙盒中的 Bash 指令先前會跳出 `bwrap: Can't create file` 錯誤。例如在符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）的家目錄底下，就可能遇到這種情況。這個錯誤現在已修好。
body.en: On Linux, you might place your working directory under `allowRead` (folders permitted for reading). If that folder sits inside `denyRead` (paths blocked from reading), sandboxed Bash commands previously failed with a `bwrap: Can't create file` error. For example, you could run into this under a home directory using a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location). This error is now fixed.

items.original: Linux: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with `bwrap: Can't create file` when the working directory was below an `allowRead` folder inside a `denyRead`, such as under a symlinked home directory

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 在分享連結時執行 /resume 或 /teleport 先中斷連線
title.en: Remote Control disconnects before /resume or /teleport on shared sessions

body.zh-TW: 當你用 Remote Control 遠端盯著一個帶有分享連結的工作階段，想打 `/resume` 或 `/teleport` 切換對話時，流程現在多了一道保護。⟦正如電視直播中要切換成另一場對外連線的轉播畫面，以前直接硬切容易混線，現在會先切斷原本的公開訊號，需要時再重新連線開播。⟧只要目前連線中的工作階段帶有分享連結，或者無法確認是否有分享連結，這兩個指令都會先中斷遠端連線；想重新接上控制，只要再執行一次 `/remote-control` 即可。
body.en: When you use Remote Control to watch a session that has a share link and type `/resume` or `/teleport` to switch conversations, the flow now includes an extra safeguard. ⟦Switching a live TV broadcast to another external feed used to risk crossing signals if cut directly, so the old public signal is now dropped first and reconnected only when needed.⟧ Both commands now disconnect the remote session first whenever the connected session has a share link or its share-link status cannot be checked; to regain control, simply run `/remote-control` again.

items.original: Remote Control: Changed `/resume` and `/teleport` to disconnect first when the connected session has a share link, or when that can't be checked; run `/remote-control` to connect again

title.zh-TW: claude remote-control 依結束原因回傳狀態碼 4 與 69 利於重啟
title.en: claude remote-control returns exit codes 4 and 69 by stop reason for restarts

body.zh-TW: 把 `claude remote-control` 交給背景服務管理程式長駐在伺服器上時，它停止運作的原因現在有明確區分。⟦跟電器面板故障時不再只亮同一顆紅燈一樣，以前師傅分不出是跳電還是零件沒接上，現在分別亮起不同代碼，自動維護裝置一看就知道該重開機。⟧程式自行停止時會回傳狀態碼 4，無法完成註冊時則回傳 69，讓服務管理程式能據此重新啟動它；單一工作階段執行結束則維持回傳 0。
body.en: When `claude remote-control` is run under a background service manager on a server, its stop reasons are now clearly distinguished. ⟦Rather than flashing the same red warning light for every appliance panel fault, where a technician could not tell a power trip from a loose part, distinct codes now light up so an automated maintenance unit knows right away when to reboot.⟧ It exits with status code 4 when it stops on its own and 69 when it fails to register, allowing the service manager to restart it accordingly, while single-session runs still exit with 0.

items.original: Improved `claude remote-control`: it now exits with status 4 when it stops by itself (single-session runs still exit 0) and 69 when it can't register, so a service manager can start it again

title.zh-TW: 帳號電子郵件檢查延伸攔截腳本、寫檔、抓網頁與 MCP 呼叫
title.en: Account email check extends to scripts, file writes, web fetches, and MCP calls

body.zh-TW: 工作進行到一半，若有人或工具試圖把你的登入信箱當作對外識別身分送出，過去只有部分管道會擋下來。⟦恰如登山隊出發前清點背包、水壺與通訊表，發現裡面不小心夾帶了私人身分證件就當場抽出來，不讓個資跟著整隊帶上山。⟧現在無論是在指令執行的腳本裡、寫入檔案、抓網頁請求，還是透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）發出的呼叫，只要把你的電子郵件填作客戶端身分，都會遭到拒絕。
body.en: If a person or tool tries to send your login email as an external identifier mid-task, only some channels blocked it before. ⟦Before a mountaineering team sets off, checking packs, water bottles, and contact sheets catches any personal ID card accidentally slipped inside and pulls it out on the spot so private data does not head up the mountain with the group.⟧ Now, whether in scripts run by a command, file writes, web fetch requests, or calls made through MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools), any attempt to use your email as a client identity is refused.

items.original: Improved the account email check: it now also refuses your email as a client's identity in scripts a command runs, file writes, web fetches and MCP calls

title.zh-TW: 終端機連續 8 回合由背景或排程觸發時降低提示建議更新頻率
title.en: Terminal slows prompt suggestion refreshes after 8 consecutive background or scheduled turns

body.zh-TW: 你暫時離開座位、讓程式自己在背景接連跑了好幾輪時，畫面其實根本沒人在看，原本卻還是一直幫你準備下一步該打什麼字。⟦宛如無人進出的展示間在連續空轉一陣子後自動調暗燈光，省下不必要的電費，等你一推開門踏進來就立刻恢復原本亮度。⟧現在只要連續 8 個回合都是由背景或排程任務啟動，終端機的提示建議就會放慢更新頻率以節省用量，直到你按下任何按鍵或回到終端機為止。
body.en: When you step away from your desk and let the program run several rounds on its own in the background, nobody is watching the screen, yet it used to keep preparing what you should type next. ⟦An empty showroom automatically dims its lights after sitting idle for a while to save wasted electricity, then snaps back to full brightness the moment you push the door open and step inside.⟧ Now, whenever 8 turns in a row are started by background or scheduled tasks, prompt suggestions in the terminal refresh less often to save usage until you press any key or return to the terminal.

items.original: Changed prompt suggestions in the terminal to refresh less often after 8 turns in a row started by background or scheduled tasks, saving usage until you press a key or return to the terminal

title.zh-TW: /cost 與預算上限納入 mod 的 complete 與 classify 呼叫計費
title.en: /cost and budget caps include mod complete and classify call billing

body.zh-TW: 當工作流程裡掛有自訂模組（mod），卻想用 `/cost` 或 `--max-budget-usd` 控管開銷時，過去的統計並沒有把模組的呼叫算進去。⟦就像水電總錶以前漏算了庭院自動灑水器的用水量，現在把那條分管也接回總錶一起計價，月底帳單和限額提醒才不會對不上數。⟧現在費用與 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）統計指標，已納入 mod 發出的 `$.model.complete` 與 `$.model.classify` 呼叫。包含 `/cost`、`$.session.usage()` 與 `--max-budget-usd` 上限控管都會一併計算。
body.en: When your workflow includes a custom mod (an add-on module) and you want to control spending with `/cost` or `--max-budget-usd`, past totals left out the module's calls. ⟦Much as a main utility meter used to leave out the water used by an automatic yard sprinkler, connecting that branch pipe back to the main meter for billing ensures the monthly bill and limit alerts finally add up.⟧ Now, cost and token (the text unit AI processes and bills by) metrics include `$.model.complete` and `$.model.classify` calls made by a mod. `/cost`, `$.session.usage()`, and the `--max-budget-usd` cap all count them together.

items.original: Changed `/cost`, `$.session.usage()`, `--max-budget-usd` and the cost and token metrics to count a mod's `$.model.complete` and `$.model.classify` calls

title.zh-TW: 內建資料視覺化技能補強靜態圖表與年齡層等順序型比例建議
title.en: Bundled dataviz skill improves static chart and ordered part-to-whole advice

body.zh-TW: 整理簡報想把調查數字畫成一眼看懂的佔比圖，有時匯出後不能互動、有時分組本身又有先後次序，以前給的挑圖方向常不夠貼切。⟦好比替顧客挑選展示架，以前不管商品有沒有分尺寸序列都拿圓盤來擺，現在會依照從小到大的順序改排成一目了然的階梯陳列。⟧這次改進了內建資料視覺化技能（dataviz skill）在靜態圖片場景下的選圖建議，也針對年齡區間這類具有自然順序的資料項目補強呈現方式。
body.en: When turning survey numbers into an easy-to-read proportion chart for a presentation, exports are sometimes non-interactive and groups sometimes have an inherent order, so past chart-picking guidance often missed the mark. ⟦Picking a display rack for a customer used to mean putting everything on a round platter regardless of whether items followed a size sequence, whereas ordered items are now arranged from smallest to largest in a clear stepped display.⟧ This update improves chart recommendations in the bundled dataviz skill (the built-in data visualization skill) for static image scenarios, and strengthens how it handles items with a natural order such as age bands.

items.original: Improved the bundled dataviz skill's part-to-whole advice for static images and for parts with a natural order, such as age bands

title.zh-TW: 修正 zstd 壓縮回應的解碼安全漏洞
title.en: Fixed decoding security vulnerability in zstd-compressed responses

body.zh-TW: 連網時，如果收到以 zstd（用來縮小資料體積的壓縮技術）壓縮的回應，程式需要解碼，把資料還原成可處理的內容。這個解碼還原過程先前有安全性問題，現在已經修好。
body.en: When connected to the network, if the program receives a response compressed with zstd (a compression technology used to shrink data size), it must decode the data back into a usable form. A security issue in this decoding process has now been fixed.

items.original: Fixed a security issue in how zstd-compressed responses are decoded

title.zh-TW: 修正異常中斷後接續工作階段偶爾遺失最近幾輪對話
title.en: Fix resumed sessions occasionally losing recent turns after an unexpected exit

body.zh-TW: 如果 Claude Code 因為當機或強制關閉而沒有正常結束，你事後重新接續該工作階段時，以前偶爾會發現最後那幾輪對話不見了。這個問題已經修好，非正常結束後接續工作階段不再漏掉近期的對話回合。
body.en: If Claude Code stopped without a clean exit because of a crash or force-quit, resuming that session later could occasionally leave the last few turns missing. This is now fixed, so resuming a session after an unclean exit no longer drops recent conversation turns.

items.original: Fixed recent turns sometimes going missing from a resumed session after Claude Code stopped without a clean exit

title.zh-TW: 工作目錄被刪後殼層指令不再退回啟動目錄執行
title.en: Prevent shell commands from falling back to the launch directory when the working directory is deleted

body.zh-TW: 你開著對話做到一半、順手把原本那個專案資料夾整個砍掉時，以前接下來跑的終端命令會悄悄跑到別的位置繼續動。現在只要工作目錄已經被刪除，殼層指令就會直接失敗並顯示提示訊息，不會再退回啟動目錄執行，讓你確認後重新下達一次。
body.en: If you delete the original project folder mid-conversation, subsequent terminal commands used to quietly keep running in a different location. Now, whenever the working directory has been deleted, shell commands fail immediately with a message instead of falling back to the launch directory, letting you confirm and re-issue the command.

items.original: Fixed shell commands running in the launch directory after the working directory was deleted; the command now fails with a message and can be re-issued

title.zh-TW: Agent SDK 呼叫 applyFlagSettings() 含無效值時改為報錯拒絕
title.en: Refuse Agent SDK applyFlagSettings() calls with an error when given an invalid value

body.zh-TW: 開發者透過 Agent SDK 呼叫 `applyFlagSettings()` 設定旗標時，以前只要其中夾帶了一個無效設定值，前面幾次呼叫存好的所有設定就會悄悄全被清掉。現在碰到會造成這種情況的呼叫，會直接報錯拒絕而不覆寫原有設定。
body.en: When developers called `applyFlagSettings()` through the Agent SDK to configure flags, including even a single invalid value used to silently wipe out all settings saved by earlier calls. Now, any call that would cause this is refused with an error instead of overwriting the existing settings.

items.original: Fixed one invalid value in an Agent SDK `applyFlagSettings()` call silently discarding all settings from earlier calls; a call that would do this is now refused with an error

title.zh-TW: PR 僅待你審查或合併時工作階段不再誤標為等待輸入
title.en: Stop marking sessions as waiting for input when a PR only needs your review or merge

body.zh-TW: 交代下去的程式碼改動已經送出、其實只差你自己點頭過關就好，以前清單卻還顯示要你繼續打字，讓你誤以為還要下指令。現在提取請求（PR）僅待你審查或合併時，工作階段不會再誤標為「等待輸入」。
body.en: When the requested code changes have already been submitted and only need your own approval, the list used to still show that it was waiting for you to type, making you think another instruction was needed. Now, when a pull request only needs your own review or merge, the session is no longer mistakenly marked as "waiting for input".

items.original: Fixed sessions showing as waiting for input when a finished pull request only needed your own review or merge

title.zh-TW: 修正 Dispatch 等簡短模式工作階段重複送出同一則回覆
title.en: Fix brief-mode sessions like Dispatch sending duplicate replies

body.zh-TW: 用精簡版介面跟 AI 一問一答時，有時明明已經看到答案寫出來了，畫面卻莫名其妙又多跳出一模一樣的段落。這版修好了 Dispatch 等簡短模式（brief-mode）工作階段在同一回合重複送出回覆的問題。
body.en: When going back and forth with AI in the compact interface, the screen would sometimes inexplicably pop up an identical block of text even after the answer was already shown. This release fixes the issue where brief-mode sessions such as Dispatch sent the same reply again in the same turn.

items.original: Fixed brief-mode sessions, such as Dispatch, sending a reply again after the turn had already replied

title.zh-TW: 修正 /teleport 在特殊 Git 狀態下選錯暫存並改為停下提示
title.en: Fix /teleport picking the wrong stash in unusual Git states and stop with instructions

body.zh-TW: 執行 `/teleport` 把工作階段搬移到其他環境時，如果儲存庫剛好處於某些不常見的 Git 狀態，過去程式挑選暫存（stash）的方式會出錯。現在遇到這種狀況會先停下來，並清楚告訴你接下來該怎麼做。
body.en: When running `/teleport` to move a session to another environment, if the repository happened to be in certain unusual Git states, the way it chose a stash used to go wrong. Now, when this happens, it stops first and clearly tells you what to do next.

items.original: Fixed `/teleport`'s stash choice in some unusual git states: it now stops and says what to do

title.zh-TW: VS Code 版同步顯示下一步提示建議，按 Tab 即可採用
title.en: Show next-prompt suggestions in VS Code and accept them with Tab

items.original: [VSCode] Added prompt suggestions wherever the terminal shows them: Tab accepts the suggested next prompt; `promptSuggestionEnabled: false` in Claude Code's settings.json turns them off

title.zh-TW: VS Code 版新增無金鑰主控台登入與遠端視窗 MCP 驗證欄位
title.en: Add keyless Console sign-in and remote-window MCP auth field in VS Code

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 裡處理帳號與外部工具驗證時，這版補齊了幾項遠端與企業環境需要的入口。登入選項現在新增不會自動建立 API 金鑰的主控台（Console）登入方式，而登入畫面也不會再端出已被管理設定 `allowedProviders` 拒絕的登入管道。

在 SSH、WSL 或容器視窗裡從面板登入 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，現在多了一個輸入框讓你直接貼上重新導向網址完成驗證。若瀏覽器跳出 `localhost` 連線錯誤，登入卡片上也會明確說明接下來該怎麼處理。
body.en:
When handling account and external tool authentication in VS Code, this release fills in several entry points needed for remote and enterprise environments. Sign-in options now include a Console sign-in that does not automatically create an API key, and the sign-in screen no longer offers sign-in methods refused by the managed `allowedProviders` setting.

When signing in to an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) server from the panel inside SSH, WSL, or container windows, there is now an input field where you can paste the redirect URL directly to finish authentication. If the browser shows a `localhost` connection error, the sign-in card also clearly explains what to do next.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a Console sign-in that creates no API key
[VSCode] Added a field to paste the redirect URL when signing in to an MCP server from the panel in SSH, WSL and container windows
[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen offering sign-ins that the managed `allowedProviders` setting refuses
[VSCode] Improved the sign-in card to say what to do when the browser shows a connection error for localhost

title.zh-TW: VS Code 版修正模型勾選殘留、推理上限與 MCP 安全提示
title.en: Fix stale model check mark, effort cap, and MCP safety prompt in VS Code

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 面板切換設定與核對工具權限時，先前有三個畫面對不上真實狀態的問題已修正。當 Claude Code 重啟並改用其他模型、或透過 Remote Control 切換模型後，模型選擇器上的勾選記號不會再死守著舊模型。

推理力度選擇器（effort selector）以前會列出超過組織上限或 `maxEffortLevel` 設定的選項，現在只會顯示允許的範圍。當安全檢查觸發 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具的授權詢問時，視窗現在也會說明 Claude Code 為什麼要問你。
body.en:
When switching settings and checking tool permissions in the VS Code panel, three issues where the UI did not match the actual state have been fixed. After Claude Code restarts on another model or switches models over Remote Control, the check mark in the model picker no longer stays stuck on the old model.

The effort selector used to list options above the cap set by your organization or the `maxEffortLevel` setting, and now only shows what is allowed. When a safety check triggers a permission prompt for MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tools, the dialog now also explains why Claude Code is asking.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the model picker's check mark staying on the old model after Claude Code restarted on another model or the model was switched over Remote Control
[VSCode] Fixed the effort selector offering levels above the effort cap set by your organization or the `maxEffortLevel` setting
[VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt for MCP tools not saying why Claude Code asks when a safety check raises the question

title.zh-TW: VS Code 版調整未信任資料夾、系統封鎖與市集確認提示
title.en: Update untrusted folder, OS block, and marketplace prompts in VS Code

body.zh-TW:
VS Code 擴充套件把幾則設定失敗與安全攔截的提示改得更符合現場操作。組織設定載入失敗時，訊息不再叫你重跑某條指令，而是改為「再試一次」以對齊分頁上的 Retry 連結。

打開尚未信任的資料夾時，提示現在會說明擴充套件為何停用以及如何重新開啟；當作業系統拒絕執行 Claude Code 時，錯誤訊息也會告知可請 IT 團隊將被封鎖的程式加入允許清單。安裝連結裡的市集確認按鈕文字也改為「Trust marketplace and continue」。
body.en:
The VS Code extension updated several messages for settings failures and security blocks to better match actual usage. When organization settings fail to load, the message no longer tells you to run a command again, and instead says "try again" to match the tab's Retry link.

When opening an untrusted folder, the note now explains why the extension is off and how to turn it back on; when the operating system refuses to run Claude Code, the error message also notes that your IT team can add the blocked program to the allowlist. The marketplace confirmation button in the install link has also been changed to "Trust marketplace and continue".

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the message for organization settings that couldn't load saying to run a command again; it now says to try again, matching the tab's Retry link
[VSCode] Improved the note shown for an untrusted folder: it now says why the extension is off and how to turn it on
[VSCode] Improved the error shown when the system refuses to run Claude Code: it now says your IT team can allow a blocked program
[VSCode] Changed the install link's marketplace confirmation button to "Trust marketplace and continue"

title.zh-TW: 網頁版雲端工作階段放寬 MCP 工具搜尋說明長度至 16,384 字元
title.en: Web cloud sessions raise MCP tool search description limit to 16,384 characters

body.zh-TW: 打開瀏覽器在遠端開新任務時，一旦要臨時翻找外接功能怎麼用，以前太長的使用手冊讀到一半就會被硬生生切掉（超過 4,096 字元就截斷）。⟦好比以前寄給遠端助理的器材說明書只准印四頁，關鍵操作全被裁掉，現在放寬頁數限制後就能把整本手冊一次交到他手上。⟧現在網頁版雲端工作階段透過工具搜尋載入的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）說明上限已放寬到 16,384 個字元，跟其他環境裡的 Claude Code 工作階段一致。
body.en: When starting a new remote task in your browser and looking up how an external tool works, overly long manuals used to get cut off halfway (truncated past 4,096 characters). ⟦Previously, mailing an equipment manual to a remote assistant meant capping it at four pages and cutting off key instructions, whereas raising the page limit now lets you hand over the entire handbook at once.⟧ Now the limit for MCP (Model Context Protocol, a standard that lets AI connect to external tools) descriptions loaded through tool search in web cloud sessions has been raised to 16,384 characters, matching Claude Code sessions in other environments.

items.original: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed new cloud sessions cutting MCP tool descriptions loaded through tool search at 4,096 characters; the limit is now 16,384, as in other Claude Code sessions

title.zh-TW: Claude Tag 修正登入過期時 Slack 連結沒有卡片的問題
title.en: Claude Tag fixes missing cards for Slack links when sign-in expires

body.zh-TW: 當你在不歸所屬組織管理的 Slack 工作區貼上 artifact 連結時，如果貼文者當下的 Claude 登入狀態剛好過期了，過去對話裡完全不會出現任何預覽卡片。⟦宛如雜誌封底的推薦書單失效時，書店依然會在架上擺一張純白書名小卡，讓逛店的人知道這本書存在。⟧這個 Claude Tag 的顯示問題已經修好，現在同樣情境下會改為顯示一張簡潔卡片。
body.en: When you paste an artifact link into a Slack workspace not managed by your organization and the poster's Claude sign-in happens to be expired, no preview card used to appear in the conversation. ⟦Even when a recommended reading list on a magazine's back cover expires, a bookstore still places a plain white title card on the shelf so browsers know the book exists.⟧ This Claude Tag display issue has been fixed, and a plain card now appears in the same situation.

items.original: [Claude Tag] Fixed artifact links pasted in Slack getting no card when the poster's Claude sign-in had expired in a workspace their organization doesn't manage; a plain card now appears

[Code Review] Added a Download CSV button to Code Review admin settings: export review costs per repository by month, week or day, for one repository, one GitHub organization or all

title.zh-TW: Vertex 支援快速模式，全球與美歐區域遭拒時退回標準速度備援
title.en: Vertex Supports Fast Mode, Falling Back to Standard Speed in Global, US, and EU Regions When Refused

body.zh-TW: 當你請 Claude 整理長篇技術文件或規劃專案架構時，等待模型生成內容的時間往往直接影響工作步調。現在這項工具在 Vertex（Google 旗下的雲端託管平台）正式加入快速模式。⟦跟搭乘商辦大樓的直達特快電梯一樣，以前專用電梯一旦拒載，乘客只能在閘門前被退回重新排隊；現在動線會自動換走每層皆停的一般電梯，行程絕不中斷。⟧這項設定目前已在 global 全球、us 美國與 eu 歐洲三個服務區域開放。Vertex 若拒絕快速模式，就退回標準速度。
body.en: When you ask Claude to organize long technical documents or plan project architecture, waiting for the model to generate content often directly affects your working pace. This tool now officially adds fast mode on Vertex (Google's managed cloud platform). ⟦Much like riding a direct express elevator in an office building, if the dedicated elevator previously refused boarding, passengers were turned away at the gate to line up all over again; now traffic automatically switches to a standard elevator that stops on every floor, ensuring the trip is never interrupted.⟧ This setting is currently available across three service regions: global, us, and eu. If Vertex refuses fast mode, it falls back to standard speed.

items.original: Added fast mode on Vertex in the global, us and eu regions, falling back to standard speed if Vertex refuses it

title.zh-TW: 終端機工作區支援多個側邊對話分頁，重啟後可重新開啟
title.en: Terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs and reopens saved chats after restart

body.zh-TW: 專案改到一半想順便問其他問題時，單一對話窗往往不夠用。⟦就像在螢幕旁釘上好幾張各自獨立的便條，以前只有一張紙容易互相蓋掉，現在可以各寫各的，重開程式也找得回本機留存的紀錄。⟧只要開啟這個需手動啟用的終端機工作區（支援多個側邊對話分頁的模式），就能同時開出多個側邊對話分頁。例如你正請 Codex 整理一份簡報大綱，順手想再問幾個語法問題，就能另開一個分頁處理。你可以隨時用鍵盤或滑鼠在分頁之間切換，就算把 Codex 關掉重開，先前儲存在本機的側邊對話也還能重新打開。
body.en: When you want to ask unrelated questions mid-project, a single chat pane is often not enough. ⟦Think of it like pinning several separate sticky notes beside your screen: previously one sheet easily got written over, whereas now each holds its own notes and local records stay retrievable after restarting.⟧ Once you turn on the opt-in terminal workspace (a mode supporting multiple side-chat tabs), you can open several side-chat tabs at once. For example, if you have Codex drafting a presentation outline and want to ask a few syntax questions on the side, you can open another tab for that. You can switch between tabs anytime with the keyboard or mouse, and even if you close and restart Codex, previously saved local side chats can still be reopened.

items.original: The opt-in terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs. Switch between them with the keyboard or mouse, and reopen saved local side chats after restarting Codex. (#59784, #60152, #60181)

title.zh-TW: 代理指揮中心新增舊任務搜尋，可依名稱與目錄篩選
title.en: Agent command center adds search for older tasks by name and directory

body.zh-TW: 用過好幾輪 AI 任務後，想回頭找先前處理過的那一筆，往往得在一長串清單裡慢慢翻。現在在代理指揮中心（集中管理各項任務的控制畫面），可以直接搜尋過去的舊任務。你可以用任務名稱或提示詞預覽（當初下指令的開頭內容）來查。如果只記得當時放在哪個專案資料夾，也能直接輸入工作目錄（任務運作的資料夾路徑）搜尋。假設你上週請它幫忙整理會議紀錄，只要打進幾個當時寫的詞，就能立刻把那筆舊任務找出來。⟦好比在手機相簿翻找去年拍的旅遊照，以前得從最新一張一路往上滑，現在只要打地點、相簿名稱或畫面關鍵字就能直接跳到那一張。⟧
body.en: After running several rounds of AI tasks, finding a past item often meant scrolling through a long list. Now, in the agent command center (the control screen for managing tasks centrally), you can search older tasks directly. You can look them up by task name or prompt preview (the opening text of your original instruction). If you only remember which project folder a task lived in, you can also search by entering its working directory (the folder path where the task runs). Suppose you asked it to organize meeting notes last week: typing a few words you wrote then brings that older task right back up. ⟦Picture scrolling through your phone's photo album for a trip from last year: previously you had to swipe up from the newest shot, whereas now typing a place, album name, or visual keyword jumps straight to that photo.⟧

items.original: Search older tasks from the agent command center by name, prompt preview, or working directory. (#60286)

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕紀錄可折疊回合細節，保留回覆並支援搜尋工具輸出
title.en: Full-screen transcript folds turn details while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable

body.zh-TW: 對話累積了不少來回步驟後，全螢幕對話紀錄（展開檢視完整往來過程的畫面）常被大量執行細節佔滿版面。⟦想像一份夾著大疊附錄的報告，以前得一頁頁越過查證過程才能看見正文，現在把附錄對折收起來只留結論，真要核對細節時也依然查得到。⟧只要在畫面裡打開 **Collapse turn details**，每次提問底下已經完成的活動就會摺疊收起。當你請它改完報告想順著讀一遍回覆時，AI 的答案依然會直接顯示在畫面上。就算細節收起來了，被折疊的工具輸出（外部工具回傳的執行結果）還是支援搜尋，隨時能翻出需要的片段。
body.en: After a conversation builds up many back-and-forth steps, the full-screen transcript (the expanded view showing the complete exchange) often fills up with execution details. ⟦Imagine a report clipped to a thick stack of appendices: previously you had to flip past pages of verification steps to reach the main text, whereas now folding the appendices away leaves the conclusions visible while still letting you look up details when needed.⟧ Turn on **Collapse turn details** in this view to fold completed activity beneath each prompt. When you want to read straight through the reply after it finishes revising a report, the AI's answers still stay visible on screen. Even with those details tucked away, folded tool output (execution results returned by external utilities) remains searchable so you can pull up any snippet anytime.
