Other existing sessions are unaffected, though sessions created now cannot be opened by an older build that has this feature turned off. ⟦Think of filing guidelines at the check-in counter before boarding: updating them and checking in again switches to the new version, remote inquiries wait briefly for the checkpoint before the first step of takeoff finishes, and older gates cannot read the new file yet.⟧

items.original: Muse now records each session's developer instructions when it starts. When you reopen a session in the terminal (`--resume`, `--continue` or `tbh exec --session-id`) after changing `run.developer_prompt` in your settings, Muse saves the new text and uses it from the next turn. On a session whose developer instructions were set by this release's start or update, a remote send, open, list or poll made while a run is in its first step can wait until that step's checkpoint, never past the call's own deadline; other sessions see no change. Sessions created now cannot be opened by an older build that has this off

title.zh-TW: 工作階段語言鎖定改依使用者訊息於首段輸出宣告
title.en: Session language pin now declared from first output based on user messages

body.zh-TW: 專案夾雜大量英文程式碼或名詞時，你可能擔心對話回覆被裡頭的字詞帶偏語言。⟦好比飯店櫃檯直接聽住客本人說什麼語言就用那種語言回應，而不是看護照夾裡的英文備註或行李標籤亂猜，從第一句問候就說對語言，住客還沒開口前則先用英文招呼。⟧在符合條件的主執行流程中，Muse 現在會從第一段可見輸出就明確宣告你的工作階段語言釘選（鎖定這段對話該使用的回覆語言）。這個語言設定會固定依據你在該工作階段發送的訊息推算出來，不會再從名稱、程式碼或工具輸出推斷語言。當你輸入的內容還沒有明顯語言訊號時，則會採用英文作為預設語言。
body.en: When a project mixes in lots of English code or terms, you might worry that replies will be swayed by those words into the wrong language. ⟦Picture a hotel front desk listening directly to what the guest speaks and replying in kind rather than guessing from English notes in a passport holder or luggage tags, getting the greeting right from the first word and defaulting to English before the guest speaks.⟧ On eligible main runs, Muse now explicitly states your session language pin (which locks the reply choice for this conversation) from the first visible output. This language setting is derived deterministically from the messages you send in the session, rather than inferred from names, code, or tool output. When your input carries no clear language signal yet, English is used as the default.

items.original: Muse now states your session language pin on eligible main runs from the first visible output, deriving the pin deterministically from your own messages in the session (English when your input carries no language signal yet) instead of inferring a language from names, code, or tool output

title.zh-TW: 動手修改前核對更嚴謹並於受阻時先停下詢問
title.en: Stricter checks before editing and pausing to ask when blocked

body.zh-TW: 把專案交給代理查問題或修程式，最怕它太快下結論說找不到檔案，或自己繞過限制硬闖。⟦宛如老練的水電師傅進屋檢修，找不到管線先換幾個角落巡一遍、確認哪一戶報修、照原況重試一次再動扳手，碰到社區禁令或斷水閥門就停下來問屋主，絕不擅自繞道。⟧現在 Muse 動手前會把每一步核對得更仔細：宣告東西不存在前，會先試別種拼法與更寬的路徑；著手修復前，會先確認回報指向哪一份程式碼複本，並在原本出錯的環境設定下重跑具名的失敗測試。查案時也會讀取版本庫自己的歷史紀錄與上游分支。若變動受到版本庫規則禁止或管制，或是網路政策擋住某個步驟，它都會停下來詢問你，不再自己繞道處理。
body.en: When handing a project to an agent to investigate or fix, it is frustrating if it jumps too quickly to saying a file is missing or forces its way around limits. ⟦A seasoned plumber inspecting a house checks other corners before saying a pipe is missing, confirms which unit filed the report, and retries under the original conditions before touching a wrench, stopping to ask the homeowner rather than routing around a building rule or shutoff valve.⟧ Muse now verifies each step more carefully before acting: it tries other spellings and wider paths before saying something does not exist, confirms which copy of the code a report points to before fixing it, and reruns named failing tests in the setup where they failed. It also reads the repository's own history and upstream branch while investigating. If a change is forbidden or gated by a repository rule, or if a network policy blocks a step, it stops to ask you instead of routing around it.

items.original: Muse checks its work more carefully: it tries other spellings and wider paths before saying something does not exist, finds which copy of the code a report is about before fixing it, reruns named failing tests in the setup they failed in, asks before a change a repository rule forbids or gates, reads the repository's own history and upstream branch, and stops to ask when a network policy blocks a step instead of routing around it

title.zh-TW: 產出結果若落在別處直接補進指定位置
title.en: Results built elsewhere are added directly to the requested spot

body.zh-TW: 有時請代理產出內容，它卻把結果做在你最初指定以外的地方，還得你多點一次確認才肯搬過來。現在就算 Muse 把成果建在別的畫面、分頁、頁面或檔案裡，它也不會停下來問你要不要移過去，而是繼續完成並直接加進你當初要求的位置。當你在寫報告或整理筆記，指定要把段落補進某份檔案時，不用再多回一句「好，幫我放進去」就能直接看到結果到位。⟦猶如請人把整理好的資料放進指定抽屜，以前做完留在餐桌上還要問一聲要不要搬，現在會直接放進你說的抽屜才收工。⟧
body.en: Sometimes you ask an agent to produce something, and it builds the result somewhere other than where you first asked, leaving you to confirm one more time before moving it over. Now even if Muse builds a result in a different screen, tab, page, or file, it will not stop to ask whether to move it, and instead finishes the work and adds it directly where you asked. When you are writing a report or organizing notes and ask for a section to be added to a specific file, you see it land in place without having to reply "yes, put it in." ⟦Compare that to asking someone to put sorted papers into a specific drawer: before, they left them on the dining table and asked whether to move them, whereas now they place them straight into the drawer before wrapping up.⟧

items.original: Muse keeps working when it built a result somewhere other than the screen, tab, page, or file you named, and adds it where you asked instead of offering to

title.zh-TW: 長工作階段接近容量上限時改要簡短回覆
title.en: Long sessions request shorter replies when nearing capacity

body.zh-TW: 同一段對話聊久了、貼入的資料一多，最掃興的就是準備收尾時突然被一句超出容量擋在半路。⟦恰似裝行李快到登機箱極限時，工作人員不再直接拒收整箱物件，而是改請你挑最精簡的幾件塞進剩餘空間。⟧過去長工作階段只要輸入內容加上請求的輸出長度超過模型的脈絡視窗（模型單次能同時處理的文字容量），就會跳出錯誤並強制停下。現在當脈絡視窗快滿時，Muse 會主動請模型改給較簡短的回覆，讓工作階段繼續進行而不致中斷。
body.en: Nothing spoils the wrap-up of a long conversation packed with pasted material like suddenly hitting a capacity wall. ⟦When packing a carry-on approaches the size limit, staff no longer turn away the whole bag and instead ask you to pick only the most compact items for the remaining space.⟧ Previously, a long session stopped with an error whenever its input plus requested output exceeded the model's context window (how much text a model can handle at once). Now, when the context window is nearly full, Muse asks the model for a shorter reply so the session can keep going without stopping.

items.original: A long session no longer stops with an error that its input plus the requested output exceeds the model's context window: when the window is nearly full, Muse asks the model for a shorter reply instead

title.zh-TW: 含大量截圖的工作階段壓縮後最多保留約八張近期原圖
title.en: Compacted screenshot-heavy sessions keep up to about eight recent originals

body.zh-TW: 除錯或做設計時常在對話裡貼進一張張螢幕截圖，以前這類工作階段一旦執行壓縮，很容易直接跳過存檔，導致後面想接續對話無從接起。現在壓縮近期回合含大量完整尺寸圖片（例如截圖）的工作階段時，多數情況都能順利存下檢查點，讓你從該處繼續接續工作階段。壓縮後的脈絡會原封不動保留最近最多約八張完整尺寸的圖片；較早的圖片會改為摘要；若單批超過八張，該整批也會改為摘要。⟦如同整理旅行相簿，以前塞滿高畫質相片就整本卡住封存不了，現在可留下部分近期原片，把舊相片改寫成摘要；單批超過八張則整批摘要歸檔。⟧
body.en: Debugging or designing often fills a conversation with screenshots, and compacting those sessions used to skip saving a checkpoint, leaving you with nowhere to resume. Now when compacting a session whose recent turns hold many full-size images (such as screenshots), it saves its checkpoint in most cases so you can resume from that point. The compacted context keeps up to about eight recent full-size images as they are; older images are summarized, and if a single batch has more than eight, that entire batch is summarized too. ⟦Sorting a travel photo album used to stall the whole archive whenever it was packed with high-resolution shots, whereas now you can keep a portion of recent originals and turn older photos—or any single batch over eight—into summaries.⟧

items.original: Compacting a session whose recent turns hold many full-size images, such as screenshots, now saves its checkpoint in most cases instead of skipping it, so the session can resume from that point; the compacted context keeps up to about eight recent full-size images as they are; older images, and a single batch of more than eight, are summarized

title.zh-TW: 工作階段壓縮後分支或重開保留目標與背景復原
title.en: Compacted sessions keep goals and background recovery when forked or reopened

body.zh-TW:
工作階段經過壓縮後，無論是從中開出新分支還是重新打開接續，過去都容易在交接處出錯。⟦想像把長篇筆記精簡裝訂成精華冊，以前拆成新副本或重翻頁面時總會掉頁失聯，現在關鍵的索引與行程紀錄都穩穩留在冊子裡。⟧

在 `muse serve` 中針對已壓縮的工作階段分支對話（包括從它啟動的子代理），即使後續回合的指令只留在壓縮檢查點裡，現在也不再因為被判成格式錯誤的工作階段日誌而失敗。

設有目標的工作階段重新開啟後再進行分支時，就算該工作階段曾經在某個回合進行到一半時執行壓縮，現在也能順利分支而不報錯。

把工作階段壓縮並重新開啟之後，原本在背後運行的背景代理復原能力現在也能完整保留下來。
body.en:
After a session is compacted, both branching off a new conversation and reopening it to continue used to break at the handoff. ⟦Imagine binding long notes into a condensed booklet: splitting off a new copy or flipping back through pages used to drop sheets and lose track, whereas now key indexes and trip records stay intact inside.⟧

Forking a compacted session in `muse serve` (including any subagent started from it) no longer fails as a malformed session log even when later turns' instructions live only in the compaction checkpoint.

Forking a resumed session that has a goal now succeeds without error even if the session was compacted mid-turn.

Background agent recovery is now preserved after compacting and reopening a session.

items.original:
On a `muse serve` session that has compacted, forking the conversation, including a subagent that starts from it, no longer fails as a malformed session log when a later turn's instructions are kept only by the compaction checkpoint
Preserve background agent recovery after compacting and reopening a session
Forking a resumed session that has a goal no longer fails when the session compacted in the middle of a turn

title.zh-TW: 精簡長工作階段大量子代理的存檔與記憶體佔用
title.en: Trim saved state and memory use for long sessions with many subagents

body.zh-TW:
接手跑了很久、中途派過不少子代理分頭做事的對話時，以前重開畫面常覺得越跑越沉，甚至等半天才看到回覆。⟦彷彿爬山途中把已經吃完的乾糧包裝收進回收袋輕裝上路，過去空盒子全都繼續背在肩上越走越沉，現在只留沿途還用得上的補給。⟧

啟動大量子代理的長工作階段不會再突然停止儲存檢查點：只要某個子代理已經結束、主代理也已讀過它的結果（例如等待它完成），就算沒人手動關閉，只要對話不再提及它就會自動從存檔的工作階段中移除。

重開長工作階段時佔用的記憶體變少了，因為保留在記憶體裡的每筆工具任務紀錄體積都更小。

重開包含長串子代理歷史的工作階段後，畫面顯示回覆的延遲也獲得縮減。

重開帶有許多已完成子代理的工作階段時，首次讀取每個子代理會耗用更少記憶體並減少處理工時，因為已完成子代理的工具歷史不再被複製進追蹤子代理嘗試次數的紀錄簿裡。
body.en:
When picking up a long-running conversation that spawned many subagents to split the work, reopening the screen used to feel sluggish and take ages to show a reply. ⟦On a mountain hike, packing empty ration wrappers into a recycling bag lightens the load—instead of carrying every empty box on your shoulders and growing heavier, you keep only the supplies still needed along the trail.⟧

Long sessions that start many subagents no longer stop saving checkpoints: once a subagent finishes and the main agent has read its result (for example by waiting for it to finish), it automatically drops out of the saved session as soon as the conversation stops mentioning it, even if nobody closed it manually.

Resuming a long session uses less memory because each tool-task record kept in memory is smaller.

Reply display delays after resuming sessions with long subagent histories are also reduced.

Resuming a session with many finished subagents uses less memory and less work when first reading each of them, because a finished subagent's tool history is no longer copied into the bookkeeping that tracks subagent attempts.

items.original:
Long sessions that start many subagents no longer stop saving checkpoints: a subagent that finished and whose result the main agent already read, for example by waiting for it, now drops out of the saved session once the conversation no longer mentions it, even if nobody closed it
Resuming a long session uses less memory, because each tool-task record kept in memory is smaller
Reduce reply display delays after resuming sessions with long subagent histories
Resuming a session with many finished subagents uses less memory and does less work when it first reads each of them, because a finished subagent's tool history is no longer copied into the bookkeeping that tracks subagent attempts

title.zh-TW: 補齊工作流程取消拒絕原因與暫停重開狀態
title.en: Clarify Workflow Cancel Refusals and Preserve Pause and Resume State

body.zh-TW:
操作工作流程遇到取消被拒、暫停或重開接續時，以前往往摸不清失敗原因或弄丟額度設定。

當 `muse serve` 拒絕取消某個工作流程時，錯誤訊息裡新增的 `stopRefusal` 欄位會直接寫出確切的拒絕原因，例如 `stale_revision`。

如果取消工作流程的動作遇上工作階段儲存錯誤，`muse serve` 現在會附帶原因正式拒絕，不再直接回傳內部錯誤。

重新接續同一個 Workflow 時，使用者設定的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）上限會原封不動保留下來。

暫停工作流程時，還沒跑完的背景工作不會再被誤報成遺失結果。過去在取消遇錯時只見內部錯誤、暫停時被報遺失結果，現在每種狀況都有清楚交代與保留。
body.en:
When a workflow cancel was refused, paused, or resumed, it was previously hard to tell why it failed or your limit settings would be lost.

When `muse serve` refuses to cancel a workflow, the new `stopRefusal` field in the error message now names the exact refusal reason, such as `stale_revision`.

If canceling a workflow hits a session storage error, `muse serve` now formally refuses it with a reason instead of returning an internal error.

When resuming the same Workflow, the user's limit on tokens (text units for AI processing and billing) is preserved intact.

When pausing a workflow, unfinished background work is no longer misreported as a missing result. Previously, cancel errors only showed an internal error and pauses reported missing results, whereas now every case is clearly explained and preserved.

items.original:
A workflow cancel that `muse serve` refuses now names the exact stop refusal in the error's new `stopRefusal` field, for example `stale_revision`
A workflow cancel that hits a session storage error is now refused with a reason by `muse serve` instead of failing with an internal error
Resuming the same Workflow preserves the user's token limit
Pausing a workflow no longer reports unfinished background work as a missing result

title.zh-TW: 修正忙碌時的訊息排隊、收回與中斷重送行為
title.en: Fix Message Queuing, Take-Back, and Interrupt Retries While Busy

body.zh-TW:
代理正在忙著處理任務時，你送出的新指令、插話或停止訊號以前常卡在交接空檔裡。⟦拿客滿時段的咖啡廳吧台來說，點單慢一點確認也不會把點單紙退回客人手裡，真要抽單而吧台塞滿時會等一下再請你重試，喊停時服務生也會再喊一聲確保停下。⟧

當代理忙碌時送出或排隊的訊息，若代理確認較慢，不會再跳出「steer failed」並退回輸入框，而是會維持在排隊狀態並順利送達一次。

用來中斷子代理的訊息，在替代的子代理啟動後，就會停止顯示為排隊中。

在 `muse serve` 裡，若某個卡住的工作階段指令佇列已滿，你想收回排隊中的訊息時，不會一直等到工作階段復原，改成在 30 秒後回傳可重試的忙碌錯誤。

按下停止（Stop）時，如果主機回報正在忙碌，Stop 會再次送出中斷訊號，讓執行中的回合真正停下來，不會繼續往下跑。
body.en:
When an agent was busy handling a task, new instructions, interruptions, or stop signals you sent often got stuck in handoff gaps. ⟦Consider a packed coffee counter: even if an order takes a moment to confirm, the ticket is not handed back to the customer, a cancellation at a jammed counter waits briefly before asking you to retry, and a call to stop is echoed again so work actually halts.⟧

A message sent or queued while the agent is busy no longer shows "steer failed" and returns to the input box if the agent is slow to confirm it; instead, it stays queued and is delivered once.

Messages used to interrupt a subagent stop showing as queued once the replacement subagent starts.

In `muse serve`, if a stuck session's command queue is full and you try to take back a queued message, it no longer waits until the session recovers and instead returns a retryable busy error after 30 seconds.

When you press Stop, if the host says it is busy, Stop sends the interrupt signal again so the running turn actually stops instead of continuing.

items.original:
In `muse serve`, taking back a queued message on a stuck session whose command queue is full now fails after 30 seconds with a busy error you can retry, instead of waiting until the session recovers
Messages that interrupt a subagent stop showing as queued when its replacement starts
Stop sends its interrupt again when the host says it is busy, so the running turn stops instead of running on
A message sent or queued while the agent is busy no longer shows "steer failed" and comes back to the input box when the agent is slow to confirm it; it stays queued and is delivered once

title.zh-TW: 工作階段協定為用戶端補齊狀態、錯誤與回執欄位
title.en: Session Protocol Adds Status, Error, and Receipt Fields for Clients

body.zh-TW:
開發自己的操作介面時，若想即時掌握背景執行進度或失敗原因，這套通訊規範（session protocol）現在提供更明確的訊號。

父工作階段在同伺服器開啟時，讀取子代理 `session/read` 會帶 `modelTurnRunning`，標明是否仍在跑模型回合。

`TurnErrorKind` 新增兩個不可重試類型：`reasoningReplayRefused` 為換模型後無法接續，`contextOverflow` 為超出脈絡視窗，既有比對會由預設分支接住。

開啟 Bash 標題時，殼層指令 `toolCall` 會帶安全顯示的短 `bashTitle`，免解析模型原文即可標記。

主體完成回執會以專屬歷史列送達，逾時、被插話轉向或被壓縮的工具主體都能保住結果與展開狀態。
body.en:
When building your own interface, the session protocol now gives clearer signals for tracking background progress or failure causes in real time.

When the parent session is open on the same server, reading a subagent via `session/read` now includes `modelTurnRunning` to indicate whether a model turn is still running.

`TurnErrorKind` adds two non-retryable types: `reasoningReplayRefused` for chats that cannot continue after a model switch, and `contextOverflow` for exceeding the context window; existing matches are caught by their default branch.

While Bash titles are enabled, a shell command `toolCall` carries a short, display-safe `bashTitle` so rows can be labeled without parsing the model's raw text.

Body-completion receipts arrive as dedicated history rows, preserving the results and expansion state of timed-out, steered, or compacted tool bodies.

items.original:
`session/read` of a subagent session now carries `modelTurnRunning`, which says whether the subagent is still running a model turn, when its parent session is open on the same server
`TurnErrorKind` gains `reasoningReplayRefused` (a chat that cannot continue after a model switch) and `contextOverflow` (a turn that cannot fit the model's context window), both not retryable, so session-protocol clients can tell these two failures apart; existing matches receive them in their catch-all arm
A session protocol `toolCall` item of a shell command now carries a short, display-safe title for the command (`bashTitle`) while Bash titles are on, so a client can label the row without parsing the model's raw text
Body-completion receipts now reach session-protocol clients as dedicated history rows, so a timed-out, steered, or compacted-away tool body keeps its result and expansion state on the client instead of dropping them

title.zh-TW: TypeScript SDK 支援傳入模擬主機函式進行測試
title.en: TypeScript SDK Supports Passing a Fake Host Function for Testing

body.zh-TW: 撰寫整合 TypeScript SDK 的工具時，如果測試流程一定得啟動真實的 `muse` 程序，在本機驗證時會綁手綁腳。⟦彷彿飛行員在地面用模擬駕駛艙練習起降流程，不必每次驗證儀表都把真飛機開上跑道。⟧現在 `MuseClient.spawn` 與 `spawnMspConnection` 都接受 `spawnFn` 選項，讓你能直接對記憶體內的模擬主機跑完交握與工作階段。當你準備測試用戶端與工具之間的連線流程時，只要透過 `spawnFn` 接入假主機，就能在記憶體中直接跑完整套工作階段互動，不必真的啟動 `muse` 程序。
body.en: When writing tools that integrate the TypeScript SDK, requiring a real `muse` process for every test makes local verification cumbersome. ⟦Pilots practice takeoffs and landings in a ground cockpit simulator rather than rolling a real aircraft onto the runway every time an instrument needs checking.⟧ Both `MuseClient.spawn` and `spawnMspConnection` now accept a `spawnFn` option, letting you run handshakes and sessions against an in-memory fake host. When you are ready to test the connection flow between a client and a tool, you can wire up a fake host through `spawnFn` and run the full session interaction in memory without starting a real `muse` process.

items.original: TypeScript SDK: `MuseClient.spawn` and `spawnMspConnection` accept a `spawnFn` option, so you can run the handshake and sessions against an in-memory fake host instead of a real `muse` process

title.zh-TW: 特定主機工作階段可依管理政策於啟動時調整沙盒與網路
title.en: Sessions on Specific Hosts Can Adjust Sandbox and Network at Start Under Policy

body.zh-TW: 如果用戶端需要讓工作階段在更寬鬆的環境下運行，這項權限現在能在連線之初提出申請。由 `muse serve --per-session` 或 `muse attach --stdio` 啟動的主機上，只要用戶端選擇啟用實驗性 API，工作階段就能在 `session/start` 時關閉沙盒（隔離執行的安全環境）或開啟網路，前提是不能超出管理政策允許的範圍。在團隊允許連網存取特定資源的情境下，用戶端便能在啟動階段直接完成這項調整。⟦試想進大樓實驗室申請開放外網與解除隔離區，就算手上拿著專案的實驗通行證，能開關的幅度依然受到管理規章限制。⟧
body.en: If a client needs a session to run in a less restricted environment, that permission can now be requested right at connection time. On a host started by `muse serve --per-session` or `muse attach --stdio`, as long as the client opts into the experimental API, a session can turn off its sandbox (an isolated, secure execution environment) or open its network at `session/start`, provided it stays within what managed policy allows. In scenarios where a team permits network access to specific resources, the client can complete this adjustment directly during startup. ⟦Entering a building lab to request external network access and lift isolation works the same way: even with an experimental project pass in hand, what you can toggle is still limited by management rules.⟧

items.original: A session on a host that `muse serve --per-session` or `muse attach --stdio` starts can turn its sandbox off or open its network at `session/start`, within what managed policy allows, when its client opts into the experimental API

title.zh-TW: muse serve 支援符號連結工作區以載入自訂代理
title.en: muse serve Supports Symlink Workspaces to Load Custom Agents

body.zh-TW: 不少人習慣把專案資料夾放在別顆硬碟，再用捷徑掛進工作目錄，以前在 `muse serve` 裡這條捷徑卻會直接把工作階段擋在門外。現在只要受信任的工作區路徑是指向資料夾的符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），`muse serve` 啟動工作階段時就能正常載入該專案的自訂代理，不會再跳出「source root is a symlink」的失敗錯誤。⟦就像把門市入口設在轉角的連通道，過去警衛看到招牌後面是通道就拒收貨件，現在只要確認屬於信任範圍，照樣放行店內的專屬團隊進駐。⟧
body.en: Many people keep project folders on another drive and link them into their working directory with a shortcut, which previously caused `muse serve` to block the session at the door. Now, as long as a trusted workspace path is a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location) to a folder, `muse serve` starts the session and loads the project's custom agents normally instead of failing with "source root is a symlink". ⟦Placing a shop entrance in a corner passageway used to make the guard reject deliveries upon seeing a corridor behind the sign, but once confirmed as trusted, the store's dedicated team is now let right in.⟧

items.original: A `muse serve` session whose trusted workspace path is a symlink to a folder now starts with the project's custom agents instead of failing with "source root is a symlink"

title.zh-TW: 工作階段使用外掛期間重裝不再因權限差異失敗
title.en: Reinstalling a Plugin While in Use No Longer Fails on Permission Differences

body.zh-TW: 外掛正被某個工作階段使用中卻想重新安裝，過去常因為執行環境不同而直接碰壁。⟦恰似更換大樓電梯的保養零件，若只因早晚班技師設定的檢查權限略有不同，不會當場停用退件，而是先讓正在搭乘的這一趟安全運行，等乘客全數離開後下次保養再換新。⟧現在如果兩次安裝只是因為執行時的 umask（決定新檔案預設權限的環境遮罩）不同，例如一次從背景服務安裝、一次從終端機安裝，造成外掛頂層資料夾權限有差異，重裝時就不會再失敗。使用中的外掛複本會暫時保留不動，等那些工作階段都結束後，在下一次安裝時才會替換。
body.en: Trying to reinstall a plugin while a session was still using it often hit a wall because the execution environment differed. ⟦Replacing maintenance parts on a building elevator works the same way: if the only difference is slightly different inspection permissions set by morning and night technicians, the elevator is not halted on the spot, but allowed to finish its current trip safely and swapped out at the next service after all passengers exit.⟧ Now, if two installs differ only in the permissions of the plugin's top folder due to different runtime umasks (environment masks that set default permissions for new files)—such as one from a background service and one from a terminal—reinstalling no longer fails. The copy in use is left alone for now and replaced at the next install after those sessions end.

items.original: Reinstalling a plugin while a session is using it no longer fails when the only difference is the permissions of the plugin's top folder, which can differ when installs run under different umasks (for example one from a background service and one from a terminal); the copy in use is left alone and replaced at the next install after those sessions end

title.zh-TW: 當機或啟動中斷後可正常重開並列出取消呼叫
title.en: Reopen Normally After Startup Interruption or Crash and List Cancelled Calls

body.zh-TW: 萬一工作階段在啟動途中被中斷，或程式突然當機，重新接續時最怕既進不去也搞不清楚剛剛卡在哪。現在啟動期間遭到中斷的工作階段，重新開啟時會恢復正常進入，不再直接失敗。當機後重新接續工作階段時，畫面會顯示一則通知，列出當機當時被取消的呼叫；如果現場有印出異常結束通知，這份清單會併入其中，沒有異常結束通知時則會單獨以警告方式出現。⟦好比停電復電後重啟作業台，開機時不再因為上次沒啟動完就卡死，螢幕還會印出一張紙條列出斷電當下被迫取消的通話。⟧
body.en: If a session is interrupted during startup or the program suddenly crashes, the worst part of resuming is neither getting back in nor knowing where things stopped. Sessions interrupted during startup now reopen normally instead of failing. When resuming a session after a crash, a notice is shown listing the calls that the crash cancelled; if an abnormal-exit notice prints, this list is joined to it, and otherwise it appears on its own as a warning. ⟦Restarting a workstation after a power outage works much the same: it no longer freezes at boot just because the last startup was cut short, and the screen prints a slip listing the calls forced to cancel when the power went out.⟧

items.original:
Resuming a session after a crash now shows one notice listing the calls the crash cancelled, joined to the abnormal-exit notice when one prints, or on its own as a warning when it does not
Sessions interrupted during startup now reopen normally instead of failing

title.zh-TW: 回合存檔曾失敗時的日誌寫入降級提示不再遺失
title.en: Session Log Flush Degraded Note No Longer Goes Missing After Earlier Save Failures

body.zh-TW: 執行回合的半途若曾發生存檔失敗，結尾原本該顯示的警告提示過去在幾種情況下會悄悄不見。現在回合結束時的「session log flush degraded」提示不會再遺失。無論是回合稍早存檔失敗後中途由檢查點把工作階段日誌寫出，或是存檔失敗後該回合接著送出影片、結算了一筆跨重啟等待的工具核准，這則警示都會在回合結束時照常留下。⟦跟帳房在每日結算對帳一樣，只要當天曾有過寫帳失敗，不管中途有無補登或後來又附了影像與隔夜簽呈，結帳時依舊會把警示便條留在頁尾。⟧
body.en: If a save failed mid-turn, the warning note that was supposed to appear at the end previously vanished in several scenarios. Now, the "session log flush degraded" note at the end of a turn no longer goes missing. Whether a checkpoint flushed the session log mid-turn after an earlier save failure, or the turn sent a video or settled a tool approval that waited across a restart after a save failed, the warning still stays at the end of the turn. ⟦Bookkeepers reconciling daily accounts do the same thing: as long as a ledger write failed earlier that day, regardless of mid-day catch-up entries or later videos and overnight sign-offs, the warning slip still remains at the bottom of the page at closing.⟧

items.original:
The "session log flush degraded" note at the end of a turn no longer goes missing when a checkpoint flushed the session log after a save had failed earlier in the turn
The "session log flush degraded" note at the end of a turn no longer goes missing when a save failed earlier in the turn and the turn then sent a video or settled a tool approval that waited across a restart

title.zh-TW: 非 UTF-8 路徑下的工作階段索引不再卡死關機
title.en: Session Index Under Non-UTF-8 Paths No Longer Hangs Shutdown

body.zh-TW: 把工作階段資料夾放在含有非 UTF-8 字元的路徑底下時，以前一關掉程式就容易陷入停不下來的僵局。⟦猶如車用導航遇到認不得的亂碼路名時，不斷在原地重新計算路線而遲遲無法熄火停車，現在碰到這種奇怪路徑不再無止境重算。⟧當 `sessions` 資料夾位於不是有效 UTF-8（一種常見的電腦文字編碼標準）的路徑底下時，工作階段索引過去會反覆不斷地重寫自己，連帶讓整個程式卡在關機步驟。這項錯誤已經修好，現在工作階段索引不會再無止境重寫並卡死關機流程。
body.en: When placing the sessions folder under a path with non-UTF-8 characters, shutting down the program previously got stuck in an endless loop. ⟦Car navigation systems hitting an unreadable garbled street name behave similarly, endlessly recalculating the route in place and refusing to power down, whereas now such odd paths no longer trigger endless recalculation.⟧ When the `sessions` folder is under a path that is not valid UTF-8 (a common computer text-encoding standard), the session index previously kept rewriting itself forever and hung the shutdown step. That bug is fixed, and the session index no longer rewrites itself endlessly or hangs shutdown.

items.original: Session index no longer rewrites itself forever and hangs shutdown when the sessions folder is under a path that is not valid UTF-8

title.zh-TW: 終端機程式狀態在背景回合完成後正確回到閒置
title.en: Terminal Program Status Returns to Idle After Background Turns Complete

body.zh-TW: 自家回合曾執行失敗後，就算後續的背景排程已經順利跑完，終端機的狀態燈號以前還是會卡在舊錯誤上。在支援顯示程式狀態（OSC 7501，終端機用來接收程式狀態訊號的控制規格）的終端機裡，現在當你原本的回合失敗、之後有排程或其他背景回合完成時，狀態會正常回到閒置，不會在每次背景回合結束後又把那個舊錯誤重秀一遍。⟦若把終端機狀態燈比作洗衣機面板上的提示燈，以前上一次脫水故障亮過紅燈後，之後每次背景自動烘衣結束都會再亮一次舊故障燈，現在背景程序完成便會乖乖切回待機狀態。⟧
body.en: After one of your own turns failed, a terminal's status indicator previously stayed stuck on the old error even when subsequent background schedules finished cleanly. In terminals that support showing program status (OSC 7501, a control specification for receiving status signals), the status now returns to idle when a scheduled or other background turn completes after your original turn failed, rather than displaying that old error again after every background turn. ⟦A washing machine's panel light works the same way: after a spin-cycle fault turned it red once, every later automatic drying cycle in the background used to flash that same old fault light again, whereas now it switches back to standby once the background cycle finishes.⟧

items.original: Terminals that show program status (OSC 7501) now return to idle when a scheduled or other background turn completes after one of your turns failed, instead of showing that old error again after every background turn

title.zh-TW: 執行 /goal resume 可直接顯示答案不必重開對話
title.en: Running /goal resume Shows Answers Directly Without Reopening the Conversation

body.zh-TW: 用目標功能整理專案重點、等著看指令的答案時，若還得重新打開原本的對話才能看到結果，手上的工作就多了一道操作。使用 `/goal resume` 後，現在能直接看到該指令的答案，不必重新開啟對話。⟦好比在服務櫃檯等答覆，以前得重新推門進接待室才能聽到回答，現在站在櫃檯就能直接聽見；不必為了得到這句答覆，再把剛才離開的房門打開一次。⟧
body.en: When you use the goals feature to organize project highlights and are waiting for a command's answer, having to reopen the original conversation just to view the result adds an extra step to your workflow. After running `/goal resume`, you can now see that command's answer directly without reopening the conversation. ⟦Waiting at a service counter for a reply illustrates this well: previously you had to push open the door back into the reception room to hear the response, whereas now you can hear it right at the counter without opening the door you just walked out of again just to get that answer.⟧

items.original: Show answers from `/goal resume` without reopening the conversation

title.zh-TW: 訊息核准預覽完整保留比較運算子與底線
title.en: Message Approval Previews Preserve Comparison Operators and `_` Characters

body.zh-TW: 準備核准代理送出的訊息前，螢幕上的預覽畫面是你確認文字有沒有出錯的唯一依據。如果待送出的內容裡包含比較運算子（例如用來判斷大小的 `<` 或 `>` 符號）或是像 `user_name` 這樣帶有底線的字詞，現在的訊息核准預覽都會原樣保留這些符號與底線。⟦假想印刷廠送印前給你一張校對樣張，過去某些大於小於記號和底線常在樣張上漏印，現在每個符號都安安穩穩印在紙面上供你逐字確認。⟧
body.en: Before approving a message for the agent to send, the preview on your screen is your only basis for checking whether any text went wrong. If the outgoing content contains comparison operators (such as `<` or `>` symbols for checking size) or terms with `_` characters like `user_name`, message approval previews now preserve those symbols and `_` characters intact. ⟦Print-shop proof sheets work the same way: before a press run, you rely on a proof sheet where greater-than, less-than, and `_` marks used to go missing, and now every mark stays printed on the page for you to verify character by character.⟧

items.original: Message approval previews preserve comparison operators and underscores

title.zh-TW: Codex 因額度用完被拒時，卡片改顯示 100% 已用
title.en: Codex Card Shows 100% Used When Refused for Hitting the Limit

body.zh-TW: 請求剛被 Codex 擋下時，讀數往往還停在幾小時前的 99%，旁邊掛著「約 N 小時前更新」的警告。現在的 Codex CLI（在終端機打指令操作的工具）被拒後不再記錄額度，卡片才會一直留著舊讀數。現在只要有比這筆讀數更新的拒絕紀錄，被拒的窗口就會顯示 100% 已用，重置時間照舊，資料新舊從被拒那一刻算起。等那個窗口重置後，卡片會回到正常讀數，不會把 100% 移到另一個窗口。就算有其他工作階段（指單次對話或執行紀錄）比較晚修改，依然找得到另一個工作階段裡的拒絕紀錄。⟦如同停車場入口的車位燈牌，以前柵欄都放不進車卻還亮著「剩一位」，現在只要被柵欄擋過一次，該時段就立刻改掛「已滿」，等時段重置再恢復，不連累另一區。⟧
body.en: Right after Codex blocks a request, the reading often stays stuck at 99% from hours earlier, with an "about N hours ago" warning next to it. Current Codex CLI (a tool you run by typing commands in a terminal) no longer logs quota after a refused run, which is why the card kept showing the old reading. Now, as long as there is a refusal record newer than that reading, the refused window shows 100% used, keeps its reset time, and counts the data's age from the moment of the refusal. Once that window resets, the card goes back to the normal reading instead of moving the 100% to the other window. Even if another session (a single conversation or run record) was modified more recently, a refusal record in a different session can still be found. ⟦Picture a parking garage entrance sign that used to keep showing "1 spot left" even when the gate could no longer let cars in; now, once the gate blocks a car, that time slot immediately flips to "Full" and returns to normal when the slot resets, without affecting the other zone.⟧

items.original: **The Codex card shows 100% used once Codex refuses a request for hitting its limit.** Current Codex CLI no longer logs quota after a refused run, so the card kept the last reading, such as 99% from hours earlier, with an "about N hours ago" warning. A refusal newer than that reading now marks the refused window as 100% used, keeps its reset time, and counts the data's age from the refusal. Once that window resets, the card goes back to the normal reading instead of moving the 100% to the other window. A refusal in another session is found even when a different session was modified more recently.

title.zh-TW: 「設定狀態列」按鈕現在也會設定 Antigravity 與 Grok
title.en: The "Set Up Status Line" Button Now Also Sets Up Antigravity and Grok

body.zh-TW: 以前想在 Antigravity 與 Grok 啟用 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列），總要等下次開啟應用程式，或是把狀態列開關關掉再打開才會裝上。⟦就像替客廳與書房的新冷氣配對遙控器，以前按下設定鍵只連上第一台，另外兩台得重開電源才抓得到訊號；現在只要機器裝在牆上，按一次就通通配好。⟧這顆「設定狀態列」按鈕原本只設定 Claude Code，不會處理這兩個 CLI（在終端機打指令操作的工具）。現在只要裝了這兩個 CLI，按下按鈕就會馬上設定好，macOS 與 Windows 都一樣。
body.en: Previously, enabling a status line (the bar shown at the very bottom of the terminal) in Antigravity and Grok required waiting until the next app launch or turning the status line switch off and back on before it would be installed. ⟦Like pairing a remote with new air conditioners in the living room and study, pressing the setup button used to connect only the first unit while the other two had to be power-cycled to pick up the signal; now, as long as the units are mounted on the wall, one press pairs them all.⟧ This "Set Up Status Line" button originally only configured Claude Code and did not handle these two CLIs (tools you run by typing commands in a terminal). Now, as long as those two CLIs are installed, pressing the button sets them up right away, on both macOS and Windows.

items.original: **The Set Up Status Line button now also sets up the Antigravity and Grok status lines.** The button only set up Claude Code; the Antigravity and Grok CLI status lines were added on the next app launch or by turning the status line switch off and on. They are now set up right away when those CLIs are installed, on macOS and Windows.

title.zh-TW: 額度感知模式補記 Antigravity 對話模型，同分類新品不再漏報
title.en: Quota-aware mode now records Antigravity conversation models so new ones in the same group aren't missed

body.zh-TW: 開著 usage 等新模型消息時，像 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 這類加進既有群組的新選項，過去根本不會跳通知。原本額度感知模式（偵測新模型並發送提醒的功能）只用額度池記錄 Antigravity。但額度池（只列 Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro 這類大分類的用量群組）只有粗略分類，所以加進既有額度池的新模型永遠不會被通知。現在 usage 也會記錄你在 Antigravity 對話裡用過的模型，並去掉強度與方案尾巴，讓同一個模型只通知一次。已用過的 Antigravity 模型則直接記成已知，更新後不會被當成新模型通知。⟦好比百貨樓層表以前只列「家電」「運動」大分類，舊樓層裡新開專櫃從不廣播；現在連造訪過的櫃位名稱都記下來，同區進駐新品牌才叫得出名字。⟧
body.en: When keeping usage open for news on new models, new options added to an existing group like Gemini 4 Hydrogen used to never trigger a notification. Originally, quota-aware mode (the feature that detects new models and sends alerts) recorded Antigravity only by quota group. Because quota groups (usage pools that only list broad families like Gemini Flash and Gemini Pro) only have coarse categories, any new model added to an existing group was never announced. Now usage also records models you have used in Antigravity conversations, stripping effort and tier suffixes so each model is announced only once. Antigravity models you have already used are marked as known right away, so updating won't announce them as new. ⟦Picture a department store directory that used to list only broad sections like "Appliances" and "Sports," never announcing a new counter opening on an existing floor; now it logs the names of counters you have visited, so a new brand moving into the same zone can actually be called out by name.⟧

items.original: **New Antigravity models are now noticed by quota-aware mode.** usage recorded Antigravity only by quota group, and those groups list broad families such as Gemini Flash and Gemini Pro, so a new model added to an existing group, like Gemini 4 Hydrogen, was never announced. Models from your Antigravity conversations are now recorded too, with effort and tier suffixes removed so each model is announced once. Antigravity models you have already used are recorded as known, so updating does not announce them as new.

title.zh-TW: 資料過期警告改放圖示與提示框，不再擠掉「設定」按鈕
title.en: Stale-data warning now uses icons and a tooltip so it no longer crowds out the "Settings" button

body.zh-TW: 把 usage 面板裡的 Claude 和 Codex 隱藏起來後，「設定」按鈕會移到 Antigravity、Grok 或 Muse 卡片上，原本的「約 N 分鐘前」文字卻會把按鈕推出卡片邊緣。⟦就像窄窄的櫃檯立牌硬塞進完整時間字樣，排在後面的按鈕自然被推出桌邊；現在立牌只留警告圖示，把時間收進旁邊的折疊說明卡，太長的店名必要時也縮短。⟧現在放著「設定」按鈕的那張卡片，資料過期警告只會顯示圖示，時間資訊改放進 ⓘ 提示框（滑鼠移過去才會展開的補充說明）。Antigravity 的標題在必要時也會縮短。每張卡片的 ⓘ 提示框開頭現在也都會先寫出時間。
body.en: When Claude and Codex are hidden in the usage panel, the "Settings" button moves to the Antigravity, Grok, or Muse card, where the original "about N minutes ago" text used to push the button past the card's edge. ⟦A narrow counter sign crammed with a full timestamp naturally shoves the button lined up behind it off the table's edge; now the sign keeps only the warning icon, tucks the time into the folded info card beside it, and shortens an overly long shop name if needed.⟧ On the card holding the "Settings" button, the stale-data warning now shows only icons, moving the time into the ⓘ tooltip (extra info that expands when you hover over it). The Antigravity title also shortens when needed. Every card's ⓘ tooltip now starts with the time as well.

items.original: **A stale-data warning no longer pushes the Settings button out of the panel.** When Claude and Codex are hidden, the Settings button moves to the Antigravity, Grok, or Muse card, and that card's "about N minutes ago" warning pushed it past the card's edge. On the card that holds the button, the warning now shows only its icons and the age moves into the ⓘ tooltip; the Antigravity title shortens if needed. The tooltip now starts with the age on every card. Reported in #341.

title.zh-TW: Windows 版也會發現 Claude Code 與其他工具的新模型
title.en: Windows now notices new models from Claude Code and other tools too

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 電腦上用這套工具追蹤各家 AI 額度時，過去並非所有工具的新模型都會跳通知。⟦跟賞鳥社團的通報一樣，以前名冊漏抄了個人日誌，只會播報兩處保護區的新鳥；現在先把日誌裡見過的鳥記成已知，其他棲地來新鳥也會通知，換新名冊後也不會重報舊鳥。⟧會這樣是因為 Windows 系統匣（桌面右下角放常駐圖示的區域）記錄看過的模型時，漏掉了用量紀錄裡的模型，因此 Windows 上的額度感知模式只會通知 Codex 新模型與 Antigravity 額度池。現在記錄看過的模型時不再漏掉用量紀錄，Windows 也會發現 Claude Code 與其他工具的新模型。你已經用過的模型會直接記成已知，更新版本後不會被當成新模型通知。
body.en: When you track AI quotas across providers with this tool on Windows, not every tool's new models used to trigger a notification. ⟦A birdwatching club's alert works the same way: previously, its roster left out personal logs and only announced new birds from two reserves; now it records birds seen in those logs as known first, so new birds from other habitats are announced too, and old birds are not reported again after switching to a new roster.⟧ This happened because the Windows system tray (the bottom-right desktop area for background icons) left out the models in your usage logs when recording seen models, so quota-aware mode on Windows only announced new Codex models and Antigravity quota groups. Now that recording seen models no longer skips your usage logs, Windows also notices new models from Claude Code and other tools. Models you have already used are recorded as known right away, so updating versions does not announce them as new.

items.original: **New models from Claude Code and other tools are now noticed on Windows too.** The Windows tray left out the models found in your usage logs when it recorded seen models, so quota-aware mode on Windows only announced new Codex models and Antigravity quota groups. Models you have already used are recorded as known, so updating does not announce them as new.

title.zh-TW: gh repo delete 刪除私人或內部儲存庫會要求額外確認 fork
title.en: gh repo delete requires extra fork confirmation when deleting private or internal repositories

body.zh-TW:
清理團隊舊專案時，你可能會在終端機敲指令把整個儲存庫（集中存放專案檔案與修改紀錄的空間）刪掉。⟦就像拆掉營地的主帳篷一樣，以前交出免確認單就直接拆走，現在只要旁邊還連著隊友的小帳篷，管理員就會先喊停再問一次，連無人拆除車都得先拿到連帶拆除授權才動工。⟧

當你用 `gh repo delete` 刪除私人或內部儲存庫，而且會連帶刪掉底下的 fork（從原專案複製出的獨立複本）時，工具會跳出警告。就算指令已經附上 `--yes`（略過一般詢問的參數），你還是得完成這項額外確認。

如果是靠排程腳本這類非互動式工作流程（無法等待人工輸入的執行環境），或交給替你自動跑指令的代理程式來刪，就必須在指令裡明確同意連帶刪除：

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```
body.en:
When cleaning up old team projects, you might run a command in your terminal to delete an entire repository (a central space storing project files and change history). ⟦Picture tearing down a campsite's main tent: previously, handing in a no-confirmation slip meant taking it straight down, whereas now, as long as teammates' smaller tents are still attached beside it, the manager stops and asks again, and even an unmanned demolition rig must get cascading-demolition authorization before starting work.⟧

When you use `gh repo delete` to delete a private or internal repository and it will also delete the forks (independent copies branched from the original project) beneath it, the tool shows a warning. Even if the command already includes `--yes` (the flag that skips standard prompts), you still have to complete this extra confirmation.

If the deletion is handled by a non-interactive workflow (an execution environment that cannot wait for human input) such as a scheduled script, or by an agent that automatically runs commands for you, you must explicitly accept the cascading deletion in the command:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

items.original:
## Protect private forks when deleting repositories

`gh repo delete` now warns when deleting a private or internal repository will also delete its forks. The additional confirmation is required even with `--yes`.

Non-interactive workflows and agents must explicitly accept the cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

title.zh-TW: --attach 憑證檢查延後至上傳端點並由伺服器裁定 GitHub App 權限
title.en: Defer `--attach` Credential Checks to Upload Endpoint and Let Server Arbitrate GitHub App Permissions

body.zh-TW: 在自動化流程中使用 GitHub CLI 發布內容時，若想隨附測試日誌或建置成品，通常會使用 `--attach` 參數打包檔案。⟦就像去快遞站寄送特殊包裹，以前臨櫃店員只要在清單上找不到對應代號就當場拒收，現在門市先將包裹轉交後端物流中心，由總部依照權限統一核對資格。⟧過去命令列工具會在終端機本機端提前檢查身分，容易直接攔下自動化工具的上傳請求。現在 GitHub CLI 將 `--attach` 的憑證檢查延後到上傳端點處理。GitHub 伺服器端會直接裁定哪些 GitHub App 的安裝權杖（token，向伺服器驗證身分的授權令牌）具備附加檔案的權限。使用 GitHub App 執行排程任務時，能否附加檔案，改由 GitHub 伺服器裁定；`--attach` 的憑證檢查則延後到上傳端點處理。
body.en: When publishing content in automated workflows using GitHub CLI, if you want to include test logs or build artifacts, you typically use the `--attach` flag to bundle files. ⟦Picture sending a special package at a courier station: counter clerks previously rejected parcels on the spot whenever a matching code was missing from their list, but now the station forwards packages to the backend logistics center so headquarters can centrally verify eligibility based on permissions.⟧ Previously, the command-line tool checked credentials early on the local terminal side, easily blocking upload requests from automated tools outright. Now, GitHub CLI defers `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint. The GitHub server directly arbitrates which GitHub App installation tokens (authorization credentials used to verify identity with the server) have permission to attach files. When running scheduled tasks with a GitHub App, whether files can be attached is decided by the GitHub server; `--attach` credential checks are deferred to the upload endpoint.

items.original:
Allow server to arbitrate which GitHub App installation tokens can attach files by @martinajir in [#14804](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14804)
Defer `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint by @BagToad in [#14805](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14805)

title.zh-TW: `gh` 可改用會自動續期的登入憑證（預覽）
title.en: `gh` can sign in with auto-refreshing credentials (preview)

body.zh-TW:
一般用 `gh` 登入 GitHub，拿到的 token（證明你身分的授權令牌）發下來就不會過期。現在可以改選會過期的 OAuth 憑證：`gh` 會存一把短效的 access token，另配一把會輪替的 refresh token（專門用來換新令牌的憑證）。access token 需要時會自動換新，你不必重新登入。⟦公司門禁卡改成每天自動換發的臨時卡，以前一張卡用到離職，現在卡片天天換新，你照樣每天刷卡進門。⟧這是預覽功能，要自己選擇開啟。只想這一次登入用它，打：

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

想以後每次登入都優先用它，打：

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```
body.en:
Normally, signing in to GitHub with `gh` gives you a token (the pass that proves who you are) that never expires. You can now opt into expiring OAuth credentials instead: `gh` stores a short-lived access token alongside a rotating refresh token (a credential used only to get a new pass). The access token is refreshed automatically whenever needed, so you stay signed in without authenticating again. ⟦An office swapped its permanent badges for temporary ones reissued every day: you used to keep one badge until you left the company, and now it renews daily while you still just tap in each morning.⟧ This is a preview you have to opt into. To use it for a single sign-in, run:

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

To prefer expiring credentials for every sign-in, run:

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```

items.original:
## Expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens (preview)

`gh` can now sign in with expiring OAuth credentials that it refreshes automatically. When you opt in, `gh` stores a short-lived access token alongside a rotating refresh token and refreshes the access token whenever it is needed, so you stay signed in without having to authenticate again.

To opt in for a single sign-in, run:

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

To prefer expiring credentials for every sign-in, run:

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```

title.zh-TW: 用會過期的 `gh` 憑證時，查狀態、接 git 和寫腳本要注意的事
title.en: Living with expiring `gh` credentials: status, git and scripts

body.zh-TW: 開了自動續期後，想知道憑證還剩多久，就打 `gh auth status`：它會顯示憑證能不能續期、access token 何時到期。它和 `gh auth token` 都會在需要時自動續期。github.com 和 GHE.com 支援這種 token，其他主機會退回一般不過期的 token。git 走 HTTPS 的話，建議用 git 2.46 以上，並執行 `gh auth setup-git`，讓 `gh` 當 git 的 credential helper（替 git 提供登入資料的程式）。這樣 git 不會把憑證留到過期之後。⟦跟鮮奶一樣，以前能囤一箱慢慢喝，現在得隨喝隨買。⟧腳本和擴充別把 `gh auth token` 的輸出存起來，每次要用都重新執行它；透過 `GH_TOKEN` 或 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 給的 token 則永遠不會續期。
body.en: Once expiring credentials are on, you may want to know how long yours has left. `gh auth status` shows whether a credential is refreshable and when the current access token expires, and both `gh auth status` and `gh auth token` refresh the access token automatically when needed. Expiring tokens are available on github.com and GHE.com; on hosts that do not issue them, `gh` falls back to a regular non-expiring token. If git talks to GitHub over HTTPS, the advice is to use git 2.46 or newer and run `gh auth setup-git` so `gh` acts as git's credential helper (the program that hands git its sign-in details). That way git does not cache the credential past its lifetime. ⟦Treat it like fresh milk: you could once stock up a crate and drink it slowly, and now you buy it as you need it.⟧ So scripts and extensions should not store the output of `gh auth token`; run it again each time a token is needed. Tokens supplied through `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN` are never refreshed.

items.original:
`gh auth status` shows whether a credential is refreshable and when the current access token expires. Both `gh auth status` and `gh auth token` automatically refresh the access token when needed. Expiring tokens are available on github.com and GHE.com; on hosts that do not issue them, `gh` falls back to a regular non-expiring token.

If you use HTTPS as your git protocol, we advise using git 2.46 or newer and letting `gh` act as your git credential helper by running `gh auth setup-git`. This way `gh` serves and refreshes the expiring credential for git, and git does not cache it past its lifetime.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Expiring access tokens should not be cached. Scripts and extensions that store the output of `gh auth token` will eventually hold an expired token, so run `gh auth token` again each time a token is needed. Tokens supplied through `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN` are never refreshed.

For more information, see [Authenticating with GitHub CLI](https://docs.github.com/github-cli/github-cli/authenticating-with-github-cli#using-expiring-refreshable-tokens).

title.zh-TW: 新指令 `gh issue artifact`，在終端機管理 issue 的附件文件（私人預覽）
title.en: New `gh issue artifact` manages issue artifacts from the terminal (private preview)

body.zh-TW:
規劃一個新功能時，你可能想把規劃書、流程圖或網頁原型直接掛在 GitHub issue（記錄待辦與問題的討論串）上。`gh issue artifact` 把 issue artifacts 帶到命令列，提供 `list`、`view`、`create`、`edit`、`download`、`delete` 六個指令，例如：

```shell
# Create a Markdown document with an attached image
gh issue artifact create 142 signin-plan.md --attach ./signin-flow.png

# Create an HTML document
gh issue artifact create 142 menu-prototype.html

# List or view artifacts
gh issue artifact list 142
gh issue artifact view 142 2

# Update a document or restore an earlier version
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --body-file signin-plan-v2.md
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --restore-version 5
```

⟦替每張工單配一個專屬資料夾，規劃書和原型都收在裡面，還記得每一版，想退回第 5 版也行。⟧artifacts 也能用 GitHub 網址指定，Markdown 文件可以用 `--attach` 附上圖片和影片。這是私人預覽，只有加入預覽的使用者和組織能用，而且只對加入預覽的儲存庫有效；申請方式在官方的預覽公告討論串。
body.en:
When planning a new feature, you may want to hang the plan, a flow chart or a web prototype right on a GitHub issue (the thread that tracks a task or problem). `gh issue artifact` brings issue artifacts to the command line with six commands, `list`, `view`, `create`, `edit`, `download` and `delete`, for example:

```shell
# Create a Markdown document with an attached image
gh issue artifact create 142 signin-plan.md --attach ./signin-flow.png

# Create an HTML document
gh issue artifact create 142 menu-prototype.html

# List or view artifacts
gh issue artifact list 142
gh issue artifact view 142 2

# Update a document or restore an earlier version
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --body-file signin-plan-v2.md
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --restore-version 5
```

⟦Give every work ticket its own folder that holds the plan and the prototype and remembers every version, so rolling back to version 5 is easy.⟧ Artifacts can also be addressed by their GitHub URLs, and Markdown documents take image and video attachments with `--attach`. This is a private preview: only users and organizations enrolled can use it, and the commands work only for repositories in the preview; access instructions are in the official preview announcement discussion.

items.original:
## Manage issue artifacts with `gh issue artifact` (private preview)

`gh issue artifact` brings issue artifacts to the command line. Users and organizations enrolled in the private preview can use the `list`, `view`, `create`, `edit`, `download`, and `delete` commands to manage issue artifacts.

```shell
# Create a Markdown document with an attached image
gh issue artifact create 142 signin-plan.md --attach ./signin-flow.png

# Create an HTML document
gh issue artifact create 142 menu-prototype.html

# List or view artifacts
gh issue artifact list 142
gh issue artifact view 142 2

# Update a document or restore an earlier version
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --body-file signin-plan-v2.md
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --restore-version 5
```

Artifacts can also be addressed by their GitHub URLs, and Markdown documents support image and video attachments with `--attach`.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Issue artifacts are in private preview. These commands only work for repositories enrolled in the preview. See the [Issue Artifacts private preview announcement and feedback discussion](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/205881) for access instructions and to share feedback.
